definition_zh: 使惊奇；使大为吃惊；使困惑；令人惊叹
definition_en: to surprise someone very much, often filling the mind with wonder or, in older use, with confusion
core_image: 眼前忽然一亮：意料之外的东西把整个心思攫住
scene: 小镇礼堂的舞台上，魔术师把空箱子合上又打开，里面飞出一群白鸽。The children were amazed when the empty box suddenly filled with white doves.
sceneCN: 这里 amazed 是「感到惊奇」（第 1 个义项：被意外之事强烈触动而心生惊叹）；句意为空箱子忽然装满白鸽时，孩子们都惊呆了。画面里有舞台、空箱与飞出的白鸽。

pos.zh: 动词：使惊奇；使大为吃惊；使困惑
分词形式 amazed / amazing 作形容词：惊奇的；令人惊叹的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「惊奇；惊愕」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「令人惊叹的；了不起的」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「感到惊奇的；惊愕的」
由 amazing 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「令人惊讶地；出奇地」

senses.title: To fill someone with wonder
senses.definition: to surprise someone strongly and pleasantly, so that the mind is filled with wonder
senses.definitionCN: 强烈而带愉悦地触动某人，使心里充满惊叹
senses.example: The northern lights amazed everyone on the night ferry.
senses.exampleCN: 北极光让夜航渡轮上的所有人都惊叹不已。
senses.why: The Old English verb meant to confound the mind; wonder is the milder modern form of that sudden jolt.
senses.whyCN: 古英语中这个词本指「把心思搅乱」，现代的「惊叹」是那次突然震动变得温和之后的样子。

senses.title: To stun into confusion
senses.definition: to shock or bewilder someone so that they cannot think or speak clearly
senses.definitionCN: 震动或迷惑某人，使其无法清楚思考或开口
senses.example: The sudden question amazed him into silence.
senses.exampleCN: 那个突然的问题惊得他说不出话来。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer: a blow to the mind leaves a person dazed rather than admiring.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的一层含义：对心思的一击让人发懵，而不是发出赞叹。

senses.title: To be extremely surprised
senses.definition: in the passive frame be amazed, to feel great surprise at something
senses.definitionCN: 用于被动结构 be amazed，表示对某事感到极大的意外
senses.example: We were amazed at how quickly the old market came back to life.
senses.exampleCN: 老市场恢复生气的速度让我们大为吃惊。
senses.why: The passive frame puts the event on the giving end: the happening amazes, and the person is amazed.
senses.whyCN: 被动结构让事件处在施加的一端：事情令人惊，人是被惊到的一方。

senses.title: To impress deeply
senses.definition: to impress someone very much through skill, scale or endurance
senses.definitionCN: 以技艺、规模或耐力使人深受触动、心生佩服
senses.example: Her calm under pressure amazed the whole rescue team.
senses.exampleCN: 她在压力之下的镇定让整个救援队都很佩服。
senses.why: Great skill produces the same mental shock as a sudden marvel, so the verb extends from wonders to people.
senses.whyCN: 高超的技艺带来的心理震动与突现的奇观相同，于是这个词从「奇观」扩展到「人」。

senses.title: In exclamations of approval
senses.definition: in the form amazing, used as an exclamation to express strong approval or disbelief
senses.definitionCN: 以 amazing 形式作感叹语，表示强烈的赞许或不敢相信
senses.example: Amazing! You repaired the old radio yourself.
senses.exampleCN: 太厉害了！你竟然自己修好了那台旧收音机。
senses.why: Once wonder becomes a familiar response, it can be compressed into one word that judges the whole situation.
senses.whyCN: 当惊叹成为熟悉的反应，它就能压缩成一个词，对整个情形下判断。

intro.en: Amaze is an Old English word, not a Latin borrowing, and its history begins with confusion rather than with wonder.
intro.cn: amaze 是古英语本族词，并非拉丁语借词，它的历史起点是「混乱」而不是「惊叹」。

items.en: The verb āmasian is recorded with the sense 'to confound, stun'. It was built with the intensive prefix ā- and a stem masian meaning 'to confuse'. The deeper origin of masian is source uncertain.
items.cn: 动词 āmasian 有记载，义为「使困惑、使惊呆」。它由加强语气前缀 ā- 与表示「使混乱」的词干 masian 构成；masian 的更早来源不确定。

items.en: The noun maze is generally connected with the same confusing stem, so the family image is a mind lost in winding paths.
items.cn: 名词 maze 一般认为与这个表示「混乱」的词干有关，因此这一词族的意象是「心思迷失在曲折路径里」。

items.en: Around the year 1300 the form amazen appears with the sense 'to bewilder, perplex', still close to its Old English meaning.
items.cn: 约在十四世纪初出现形式 amazen，义为「使迷惑、使为难」，仍接近古英语的义项。

items.en: The sense shifts from confusing the mind to overwhelming it with wonder; admiration becomes the dominant tone.
items.cn: 词义从「搅乱心思」转向「以惊叹淹没心思」，赞赏逐渐成为主要语气。

items.en: Today the wonder sense dominates, while the older 'confuse' sense survives only in literary phrasing and set expressions.
items.cn: 今天「惊叹」义占主导，较早的「使困惑」义只保留在文学措辞与固定表达里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the derived family and the related maze; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of surprise with different strength.
note.cn: 形近组收本词派生出来的一族词以及与它相关的 maze；近义组收表示「使吃惊」的动词，强度各有不同。

entries.definition: The noun for the state of being greatly surprised and filled with wonder.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「惊奇、惊愕」，指大为意外并满怀惊叹的状态。

entries.definition: The present participle used as an adjective: causing great surprise or admiration.
entries.definitionCN: 现在分词作形容词，义为「令人惊叹的、了不起的」，指引起强烈意外或赞赏。

entries.definition: The past participle used as an adjective: feeling great surprise.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词作形容词，义为「感到惊奇的」，指人处在强烈意外之中。

entries.definition: A network of paths designed to confuse; generally connected with the same confusing stem as amaze.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「迷宫、错综的路径」；一般认为与 amaze 同出表示「混乱」的词干。

entries.definition: To surprise very greatly, often with a sense of something hard to believe.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使十分惊讶」，常含「难以置信」的意味，语气比 amaze 略轻。

entries.definition: To shock with surprise; stronger and more violent than amaze.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使震惊」，强度与冲击感都比 amaze 更强。

entries.definition: To cause mild or sudden surprise; the most neutral member of the group.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使意外、使吃惊」，是这一组里最中性的词，未必带赞叹。

entries.definition: To confuse completely, leaving someone unable to understand or decide.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使迷惑、使不知所措」，偏重困惑而不是赞叹，与 amaze 的较早义项相近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English stem, its related noun, and the frames the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的古英语词干、与它相关的名词，以及这个词实际出现的句式。

normal.en: The core is ā- plus masian: an intensive prefix striking a mind into confusion.
normal.cn: 核心是加强前缀 ā- 加 masian：把心思打进一团混乱。

normal.en: Maze and amaze are generally linked, so picture a mind lost in a maze of hedges.
normal.cn: maze 与 amaze 一般认为同源，可以想象心思迷失在树篱迷宫里。

normal.en: The everyday frame is be amazed at or be amazed by something.
normal.cn: 日常句式是 be amazed at 或 be amazed by，表示对某事感到惊奇。

normal.en: Amazing describes the thing that causes wonder; amazed describes the person who feels it.
normal.cn: amazing 形容引起惊叹的事物，amazed 形容感到惊叹的人。

normal.en: Amazement adds -ment, turning the event into a lasting state of mind.
normal.cn: amazement 加 -ment，把一次事件变成持续的心境。

abstract.en: Picture a white dove leaving an empty box: the box is ordinary, the result is not, and that gap is the feeling of amaze.
abstract.cn: 想象一只白鸽从空箱里飞出：箱子很普通，结果却不普通，那个落差就是 amaze 的感觉。

abstract.en: Picture a hall of mirrors where every turn opens a new corridor: the mind expects an exit and keeps being surprised.
abstract.cn: 想象一座镜子宫殿，每次转身都开出一条新走廊：心思以为找到出口，却一再被惊到。

abstract.en: Picture one small light switched on in a dark room: nothing in the room changed, yet everything is suddenly visible.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗房间里亮起一盏小灯：房间本身没有变，一切却忽然看得见了。

examples.en: The children were amazed when the empty box suddenly filled with white doves.
examples.cn: 空箱子忽然装满白鸽时，孩子们都惊呆了。

examples.en: Her knowledge of the old dialects amazed the visiting scholars.
examples.cn: 她对古老方言的了解让来访的学者们十分惊叹。

examples.en: It amazes me that the little shop has survived for a century.
examples.cn: 那家小店竟然撑过了一百年，这让我很吃惊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿妹惊」——阿妹一抬头，满屋白鸽，惊得说不出话：使惊奇

root: 古英语 āmasian「使困惑、使惊呆」由加强语气前缀 ā- 与 masian「使混乱」构成；masian 与名词 maze「迷宫」一般认为同源，更早来源不确定。词义从「使人糊涂」逐渐转为「使人惊叹」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses move from the old jolt of confusion to the modern pleasure of wonder: the mind is struck, the person is struck, and finally the feeling is shortened into an exclamation.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项从「把心思击懵」的旧义，走到今天「惊叹」的愉悦感：先是心思被击中，再是整个人被击中，最后这种感受被压缩成一句感叹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a plain box opens and something impossible comes out, and the mind stops for a moment.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个普通的箱子打开，里面出来不可能的东西，心思有一瞬间停住。

branches.en: THE WONDER LINE: the modern main sense, where surprise arrives with pleasure and admiration.
branches.cn: 惊叹线：现代主义，意外带着愉悦与赞赏一起到来。

branches.en: THE CONFUSION LINE: the oldest sense, where the mind is dazed rather than delighted.
branches.cn: 困惑线：最古老的义项，心思是被击懵而不是被取悦。

branches.en: THE EXPERIENCER LINE: the passive frame places the person at the receiving end of the wonder.
branches.cn: 承受线：被动结构把人放在惊叹的承受一端。

branches.en: THE IMPRESSION LINE: skill and endurance produce the same jolt as a marvel, so people can amaze too.
branches.cn: 印象线：技艺与耐力带来的震动与奇观相同，所以人也能令人惊叹。

branches.en: THE EXCLAMATION LINE: the feeling shrinks into a single approving word.
branches.cn: 感叹线：这种感受收缩成一个表示赞许的词。

intro.en: Amaze is built from an Old English intensive prefix and a confusing stem; English suffixes then carry the family outward.
intro.cn: amaze 由古英语加强前缀与表示「混乱」的词干构成；英语后缀再把这一词族向外扩展。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word belongs to this family, so the Latin side is left empty rather than filled with a guess.
latinIntro.cn: 这一词族没有对应的拉丁语词，因此拉丁同源部分留空，不拿猜测填补。

items.example: It gives the verb a stronger blow.
items.exampleCN: 它让动词的那一击更重。

items.example: The stem describes a mind thrown into disorder.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干描述的是被抛入混乱的心思。

items.meaning: a network of paths that confuses
items.example: The garden maze shares this confusing image.
items.exampleCN: 花园迷宫共享这个「混乱」的意象。

items.meaning: the shared stem of the family
items.example: It appears in amazed, amazing and amazement.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 amazed、amazing 与 amazement 中。

items.meaning: forming the participle and a related adjective
items.meaningCN: 构成现在分词及相关形容词
items.example: It forms amazing.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 amazing。

items.meaning: forming the past tense and participle
items.meaningCN: 构成过去式与过去分词
items.example: It forms amazed.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 amazed。

items.example: It forms amazement.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 amazement。

items.example: It forms amazingly.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 amazingly。

definition_zh: 雄心；抱负；野心；追求的目标；进取心
definition_en: a strong desire to achieve something, especially success, power or a particular aim
core_image: 心里有一团往前推的火，催人不停奔向某个高处
scene: 毕业典礼后的走廊里，两个年轻人靠着窗台谈起将来要做的事。Her ambition is to run a small clinic in the mountain village where she grew up.
sceneCN: 这里 ambition 是「志向、抱负」（第 1 个义项：想做成某件事的强烈愿望）；句意为她的抱负是在自己长大的山村办一间小诊所。画面里有走廊、窗台与两个谈未来的年轻人。

pos.zh: 名词：雄心；抱负；野心；追求的目标；进取心

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀 -ious 构成，义为「有雄心的；有野心的」
由 ambitious 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「雄心勃勃地」
由 ambitious 加否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「没有抱负的；不图进取的」
由 ambitious 加前缀 over- 构成，义为「野心过大的；目标定得过高的」

senses.title: A strong desire to achieve something
senses.definition: a strong wish to achieve a particular goal, especially one that takes effort and time
senses.definitionCN: 想要达成某个目标的强烈愿望，尤指需要长期努力的目标
senses.example: Her ambition is to run a small clinic in the mountain village where she grew up.
senses.exampleCN: 她的抱负是在自己长大的山村办一间小诊所。
senses.why: Latin ambitio first named the act of going around to gather support; the word then moved from the effort to the desire that drives it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ambitio 最初指「四处走动争取支持」这件事，后来从「奔走」转到「驱使人奔走的那股渴望」。

senses.title: A desire for power or status
senses.definition: the desire for power, wealth or high social position, often considered excessive
senses.definitionCN: 对权力、财富或较高社会地位的欲望，常被认为过分
senses.example: His ambition grew with every promotion until he wanted to run the whole company.
senses.exampleCN: 他的野心随着每次升职而膨胀，最后想掌管整个公司。
senses.why: Canvassing for public office was the original scene, so craving office and craving power keep the same word.
senses.whyCN: 奔走拉票本来就是这个词最初的场景，所以「谋求职位」与「渴求权力」一直共用同一个词。

senses.title: A specific aim or objective
senses.definition: the particular thing that a person or group wants to achieve
senses.definitionCN: 某个人或团体想要达成的具体事情
senses.example: Building a village school became a shared ambition of the whole valley.
senses.exampleCN: 建一所村校成了整个山谷共同的志向。
senses.why: The desire attaches itself to a concrete object, and the name of the desire becomes the name of that object.
senses.whyCN: 渴望附着在具体的对象上，于是「渴望」的名字也就成了那个对象的名字。

senses.title: Drive and determination
senses.definition: energy and determination shown in working toward success, without a stated goal
senses.definitionCN: 为取得成功而表现出的精力与决心，未必指向某个明确目标
senses.example: The young coach brought ambition and discipline to a tired team.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻教练给一支疲惫的队伍带来了干劲与纪律。
senses.why: Abstracted from any one aim, the word names the force itself: the push that keeps a person working.
senses.whyCN: 从任何具体目标中抽象出来之后，这个词指的就是那股力本身：推着人持续做事的力量。

senses.title: The aspiration of a group
senses.definition: the collective aim that a company, city or nation sets for itself
senses.definitionCN: 公司、城市或国家为自身设定的集体目标
senses.example: The city's ambition is to become carbon neutral within a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的目标是在十年内实现碳中和。
senses.why: A group is treated as a single person with a single desire, so an institution can carry an ambition.
senses.whyCN: 团体被当作一个有单一愿望的个人来看待，所以机构也能「怀抱志向」。

senses.title: The historical sense of canvassing
senses.definition: the older sense of going about among people to seek votes or public office
senses.definitionCN: 较古老的义项：在人群中四处走动以争取选票或公职
senses.example: In Roman elections, ambition meant walking through the city to win support.
senses.exampleCN: 在罗马的选举中，ambition 指的是走遍全城争取支持。
senses.why: This is the literal Latin scene preserved as a historical sense, before the word turned inward into a feeling.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁语字面场景保留下来的历史义项，那时词义还没有转向内心的感受。

intro.en: Ambition is a Latin political word that travelled through French and slowly turned from an activity into a feeling.
intro.cn: ambition 是一个拉丁语政治词，经法语进入英语，并慢慢从「活动」转成「感受」。

items.en: The verb ambire meant 'to go around', from amb- 'around' and ire 'to go'. In elections it meant to go round the city canvassing for votes.
items.cn: 动词 ambire 意为「绕行」，由 amb-「周围」与 ire「走」构成。在选举语境里指绕城奔走拉票。

items.en: The noun ambitio named 'a going around, a canvassing', and by extension the desire for honour and office that drove it.
items.cn: 名词 ambitio 指「绕行、奔走拉票」，进而指驱使人奔走的求荣与求官之欲。

items.en: The related noun ambitus meant 'a circuit, a compass, an extent', and also carried the political sense of canvassing.
items.cn: 相关名词 ambitus 意为「环绕、范围、周界」，同样带有拉票的政治义。

items.en: Old French ambition took the word into the language of court and office, keeping both the drive and the desire.
items.cn: 古法语 ambition 把这个词带入宫廷与官职的语域，既保留「奔走」也保留「渴望」。

items.en: English borrowed the noun in the late Middle Ages; the exact first date is uncertain, since early spellings vary.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪晚期借入这个名词；由于早期拼写不一，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The word splits in tone: aspiration and ambition sound positive, while ambition for power alone sounds negative.
items.cn: 这个词在现代分出声调：抱负与进取听起来是正面的，单纯对权力的野心听起来是负面的。

note.en: The look-alike group is the derived family built on Latin ambire; the near-meaning group gathers aims and drives with different emotional colour.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁语 ambire 派生出来的一族词；近义组收各类目标与驱动力，情感色彩不同。

entries.definition: Adjective: having a strong desire to succeed or to achieve something difficult.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有雄心的、有野心的」，指强烈想成功或做成难事。

entries.definition: Adverb: in a manner showing strong desire to succeed.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「雄心勃勃地」，以强烈求成的方式做事。

entries.definition: The scope, extent or limits of something; from Latin ambitus, a going around.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「范围、界限」，来自拉丁语 ambitus「环绕」，与本词同源。

entries.definition: Adjective: lacking ambition or aiming at very little.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「没有抱负的、不图进取的」，由本词族加否定前缀构成。

entries.definition: A hope or ambition of achieving something; more formal and often nobler in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「志向、渴望」，语气更正式，常显得更高尚。

entries.definition: The specific result that a person aims at; concrete and neutral.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，指具体要达成的结果，中性而不带情感色彩。

entries.definition: Inner energy that pushes a person to work hard; closer to the force than to the aim.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「干劲、驱动力」，更接近那股推力而不是目标本身。

entries.definition: Great energy or enthusiasm for a cause; warmer and more emotional than ambition.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「热忱、狂热」，对某项事业充满热情，比 ambition 更带情绪温度。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real Latin election scene and the family of words it produced.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的拉丁选举场景，以及由它产生的一族词展开。

normal.en: amb- is around and ire is to go: ambition began as going around the city.
normal.cn: amb- 是「周围」，ire 是「走」：ambition 最初就是绕城奔走。

normal.en: Canvassing for votes turned into craving office, and craving office turned into craving success.
normal.cn: 拉票变成求官，求官又变成求成功，词义就这样一路内化。

normal.en: Ambitious adds -ious to make the adjective; the noun keeps the bare stem.
normal.cn: ambitious 加 -ious 构成形容词，名词则保留光秃的词干。

normal.en: Ambit keeps the Latin sense of scope, a space marked out around something.
normal.cn: ambit 保留拉丁语的「范围」义，即环绕某物划出的一片空间。

normal.en: Political ambition uses the word in its oldest surviving setting.
normal.cn: political ambition 把这个词用在它最古老的场景里。

abstract.en: Picture a candidate walking a circle around a square, greeting every door: the circle is the ambition and the doors are the votes.
abstract.cn: 想象一位候选人在广场外绕圈，向每一扇门问好：那个圈是 ambition，那些门是选票。

abstract.en: Picture a flame inside a person that leans forward, always toward a higher window.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人心里有一团火，火苗一直向前倾，朝着更高处的窗户。

abstract.en: Picture a ladder whose top rung is never quite reached; the climbing is the word, not the arrival.
abstract.cn: 想象一架梯子，最上面那级总差一点才够到：这个词说的是攀爬，而不是到达。

examples.en: Her ambition is to run a small clinic in the mountain village where she grew up.
examples.cn: 她的抱负是在自己长大的山村办一间小诊所。

examples.en: He had the ambition but not the patience to learn the trade.
examples.cn: 他有雄心，却没有学这门手艺的耐心。

examples.en: The company announced an ambition to cut its waste in half by next year.
examples.cn: 公司宣布了明年把废弃物减半的目标。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺必胜」——心里喊着我一定赢，脚步就停不下来：雄心、野心

root: 拉丁语 ambitio「绕行、奔走拉票」由 ambire「绕行」派生，而 ambire 由 amb-「周围」+ ire「走」构成。字面场景是候选人在城里绕圈争取选票，词义后来从「奔走」转为「求荣求官的渴望」，再泛化为一般的雄心与野心。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses run from the concrete political circuit to the abstract inner flame: the walking, the office sought, the goal named, the drive felt, the aim of a group, and the historical literal sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项从具体的政治绕行走到抽象的心火：绕城奔走、谋求职位、被命名的目标、被感受到的干劲、团体的志向，以及作为历史义保留下来的字面场景。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person walks a circle around a crowd, then carries that forward lean inside the chest.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人绕着人群走一圈，随后把那股前倾的劲头收进胸口。

branches.en: THE ASPIRATION LINE: the desire to achieve something worthy, the modern main sense.
branches.cn: 抱负线：想做成值得之事的那股愿望，是今天的主义。

branches.en: THE POWER LINE: the same desire aimed at office and status, heard as excessive.
branches.cn: 权力线：同一股愿望指向官职与地位，听起来就变得过分。

branches.en: THE OBJECT LINE: the desire hardened into a named aim.
branches.cn: 目标线：愿望凝固成一个有名字的目标。

branches.en: THE FORCE LINE: the desire abstracted into energy and determination.
branches.cn: 力量线：愿望被抽象成精力与决心。

branches.en: THE COLLECTIVE AND HISTORICAL LINE: a group can have one aim, and the Latin circuit remains as the oldest layer.
branches.cn: 集体与历史线：团体可以共有一个目标，而拉丁语的绕行场景作为最古老的一层保留下来。

intro.en: Ambition is assembled from a Latin prefix, a Latin verb of going, and an abstract noun suffix; the rest of the family grows from the same stem.
intro.cn: ambition 由一个拉丁前缀、一个表示「走」的拉丁动词与抽象名词后缀拼成；词族其余成员也从同一词干生长出来。

latinIntro.en: All the Latin forms here are recorded words, not reconstructions; only the deeper Indo-European layer is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 这里的拉丁语形式都是有文献记录的词，不是重构形式；只有更早的印欧语层次不确定。

items.example: Candidates ambire the city before an election.

definition_zh: 救护车；急救人员；流动医院；急救转运服务
definition_en: a vehicle, aircraft or boat specially equipped to carry sick or injured people, or the medical service that operates it
core_image: 一辆车灯闪动的白色车，把伤者从出事地点送往能救人的地方
scene: 雨夜的十字路口，一辆自行车倒在地上，路人围成一圈。An ambulance arrived within four minutes and took the rider to hospital.
sceneCN: 这里 ambulance 是「救护车」（第 1 个义项：运送伤病者的专用车辆）；句意为四分钟内来了一辆救护车，把骑车人送到医院。画面里有雨夜路口、倒地的自行车与闪灯的车。

pos.zh: 名词：救护车；急救人员；流动医院；急救转运服务

collocations.zh: 救护车服务；急救转运服务
空中救护飞机或直升机

senses.title: A vehicle for the sick or injured
senses.definition: a road vehicle equipped with medical supplies and stretchers to take sick or injured people to hospital
senses.definitionCN: 装有医疗用品与担架、用于把伤病者送往医院的陆上车辆
senses.example: An ambulance took the cyclist to hospital with a broken arm.
senses.exampleCN: 一辆救护车把手臂骨折的骑车人送到了医院。
senses.why: The French name first described a walking hospital; once the hospital was mounted on wheels, the vehicle inherited the name.
senses.whyCN: 法语原名本指「会走动的医院」；当这座医院被装上轮子，名字就落到了车上。

senses.title: A specially equipped aircraft or boat
senses.definition: an aircraft or vessel fitted with medical equipment for moving patients, especially over long or difficult distances
senses.definitionCN: 装有医疗设备、用于长距离或难走路线转运病人的飞机或船只
senses.example: An air ambulance flew the injured climber to the city.
senses.exampleCN: 一架空中救护飞机把受伤的登山者送到了城里。
senses.why: The core idea is a moving treatment room, so any carrier that can hold one qualifies.
senses.whyCN: 核心观念是「会移动的救治室」，因此任何能装下它的载具都符合条件。

senses.title: A mobile field hospital
senses.definition: the older sense of a hospital unit that moved with an army close to the fighting
senses.definitionCN: 较古老的义项：随军队移动、靠近战场的医院单位
senses.example: During the war, the ambulance moved closer to the front every week.
senses.exampleCN: 战争期间，这座流动医院每周都向更靠近前线的地方移动。
senses.why: This is the original French sense: the hospital itself walked, not the vehicle that later carried patients.
senses.whyCN: 这是法语本义：会「走」的是医院本身，而不是后来运送病人的车辆。

senses.title: The crew who staff the vehicle
senses.definition: by metonymy, the paramedics and medical team travelling in the vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 借代用法，指随车出动的急救人员与医疗小组
senses.example: The ambulance was already treating the driver when we arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 我们赶到时，救护人员已经在给司机做处理了。
senses.why: The vehicle and its crew always arrive together, so the name of the container stands for the people inside.
senses.whyCN: 车与人总是一起到场，于是容器的名字就代指里面的人。

senses.title: The emergency transport service
senses.definition: the organized service that provides emergency transport and pre-hospital care
senses.definitionCN: 提供紧急转运与院前急救的有组织服务体系
senses.example: The island depends on a volunteer ambulance that runs around the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛依赖一支全天候运转的志愿急救转运队伍。
senses.why: Beyond one vehicle, the word can name the whole arrangement that keeps such vehicles moving.
senses.whyCN: 超过单辆车之后，这个词也能指让这些车持续运转的整套安排。

intro.en: Ambulance is a French military-medical coinage built on a Latin verb for walking.
intro.cn: ambulance 是法语里由军事医疗需要造出的词，底层是一个表示「行走」的拉丁动词。

items.en: The verb ambulare meant 'to walk, to go about'. It is the walking root behind the whole family.
items.cn: 动词 ambulare 意为「行走、走动」，是整个词族背后的「行走」词根。

items.en: French military medicine spoke of a hôpital ambulant, literally a walking hospital that followed the troops.
items.cn: 法国军队医疗中出现了 hôpital ambulant 的说法，字面是「会走动的医院」，随部队移动。

items.en: The phrase was shortened to ambulance, which named the mobile medical unit itself.
items.cn: 这一短语被缩略为 ambulance，用来指流动医疗单位本身。

items.en: English adopted the word in the nineteenth century, and its use spread widely in the Crimean War period. The exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪借入这个词，并在克里米亚战争时期广泛使用；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Motor ambulances fixed the word to a road vehicle, while air ambulance extended it to aircraft.
items.cn: 机动救护车把词义固定在陆上车辆上，空中救护又把范围扩到飞机。

note.en: The look-alike group is the walking family from Latin ambulare; the near-meaning group gathers the people and equipment of emergency care.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁语 ambulare「行走」衍生的一族词；近义组收急救场景中的人员与设备。

entries.definition: Adjective: able to walk, or relating to walking; also used for outpatient care.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「能走动的、与行走有关的」，也用于「门诊的」这一医疗说法。

entries.definition: Adjective: walking or able to walk; a formal medical word.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「走动的、能行走的」，属正式医学用词。

entries.definition: Verb: to walk, especially in medical descriptions of a patient.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「行走」，多用于病历中对病人的描述。

entries.definition: A person trained to give emergency medical treatment before a patient reaches hospital.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「急救员」，指在病人入院前提供紧急医疗处理的人。

entries.definition: A frame with a sheet for carrying a sick or injured person.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「担架」，指用来抬送伤病者的框架床。

entries.definition: The act of freeing someone from danger; broader than transport to hospital.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「救援」，指把人从危险中救出，范围比送医更宽。

entries.definition: A sudden serious situation needing immediate action; the condition that calls an ambulance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「紧急情况」，指需要立即处理的突发严重状况，也是叫救护车的原因。

normalIntro.en: These hooks trace the real Latin walking verb and the French military hospital behind the word.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的拉丁「行走」动词，以及这个词背后的法国军医院展开。

normal.en: Ambulare is to walk: the first ambulance was a hospital that walked with the army.
normal.cn: ambulare 是「行走」：最早的 ambulance 是一座随军行走的医院。

normal.en: French shortened hôpital ambulant to ambulance; the adjective became the noun.
normal.cn: 法语把 hôpital ambulant 缩成 ambulance，形容词变成了名词。

normal.en: Ambulatory and ambulant keep the walking sense in modern medical English.
normal.cn: ambulatory 与 ambulant 在现代医学英语里保留了「行走」义。

normal.en: Air ambulance extends the same idea to aircraft and helicopters.
normal.cn: air ambulance 把同一观念扩展到飞机与直升机。

normal.en: The crew is called the ambulance by metonymy, because vehicle and team arrive as one.
normal.cn: 急救人员也被称作 ambulance，这是借代，因为车与人是一起到场的。

abstract.en: Picture a small hospital on wheels rolling through mud, its white walls shaking, still treating whoever is inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一座装在小轮子上的医院在泥地里前行，白墙摇晃，仍在救治里面的人。

abstract.en: Picture a bright rectangle moving against a dark street: the light is not the cure, but it is the promise of one.
abstract.cn: 想象暗街上移动的一块亮色：那光不是治疗本身，却是治疗将要到来的承诺。

abstract.en: Picture a door that opens exactly where someone fell, as if the building had walked to the patient.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门正好在有人倒下的地方打开，仿佛整座建筑走到了病人身边。

examples.en: An ambulance arrived within four minutes and took the rider to hospital.
examples.cn: 四分钟内来了一辆救护车，把骑车人送到了医院。

examples.en: The ambulance crew kept talking to the injured man to keep him calm.
examples.cn: 急救人员不停地和受伤男子说话，让他保持镇定。

examples.en: In remote valleys, an air ambulance is often the only fast way to a surgeon.
examples.cn: 在偏远山谷，空中救护常常是尽快见到外科医生的唯一办法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺不能死」——车里的人一路喊着这句话，车就往医院冲：救护车

root: 拉丁语 ambulare「行走」是词根；法语把随军的 hôpital ambulant（会走动的医院）缩略成 ambulance，先指流动医院，后指运送伤病者的车辆。英语于十九世纪借入，克里米亚战争时期广泛使用；确切首见年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses follow one moving treatment room: the road vehicle, the aircraft or boat, the original walking hospital, the crew inside it, and the service that keeps it running.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项围绕同一间「会移动的救治室」：陆上车辆、空中或水上载具、最初的流动医院、车里的急救人员，以及让这一切运转的服务体系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white room with wheels moves toward the injured and carries them back to safety.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间带轮子的白色房间朝伤者移动，再把他们带回安全处。

branches.en: THE ROAD LINE: the ordinary vehicle that carries patients to hospital.
branches.cn: 道路线：把病人送往医院的普通车辆，是今天最常见的用法。

branches.en: THE AIR AND SEA LINE: the same room fitted into aircraft or boats for long distances.
branches.cn: 空海线：同一间救治室被装进飞机或船只，用于长距离转运。

branches.en: THE ORIGINAL LINE: the hospital itself walked with the army before any vehicle took the name.
branches.cn: 本义线：在任何车辆得名之前，会走的是医院本身，它随军移动。

branches.en: THE PEOPLE LINE: the crew stands for the vehicle by metonymy.
branches.cn: 人员线：急救人员借代车辆，因为两者总是一起到场。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM LINE: one vehicle expands into an organized emergency service.
branches.cn: 体系线：一辆车扩展成有组织的急救服务体系。

intro.en: Ambulance joins a Latin walking stem to a French noun suffix, and later English adds combining words for motor and air versions.
intro.cn: ambulance 把拉丁语「行走」词干与法语名词后缀接在一起，后来英语又加入 motor 与 air 这类组合成分。

definition_en: in the middle of a group, surrounded by members of it, or shared between them
core_image: 一个人走进人群，被左右前后的肩膀围在当中
scene: 清晨的山路上，赶集的人三三两两走在一起，挑着担子。The old shepherd walked among the villagers, greeting each of them by name.
sceneCN: 这里 among 是「在……当中」（第 1 个义项：处在人群中间、被成员围绕）；句意为老牧羊人走在村民当中，挨个叫出名字问好。画面里有山路、赶集的人群与挑担子的身影。

senses.title: In the middle of a group
senses.definition: positioned in the middle of a group of people or things, with members on every side
senses.definitionCN: 处在一群人或物的中间，四周都是其中的成员
senses.example: A small house stood among the pine trees above the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 海湾上方，一间小屋立在松树林中。
senses.why: The Old English phrase meant 'in the mingling', and a person in a mingling crowd is literally inside it.
senses.whyCN: 古英语原短语意为「在混合之中」，身处一群混在一起的人里，就是字面意义上的「在里面」。

senses.title: Between the members of a group
senses.definition: used when something is divided, shared or spread between several members
senses.definitionCN: 用于把某物分配、共享或分散到若干成员之间的情形
senses.example: The prize money was divided among the five sisters.
senses.exampleCN: 奖金在五姐妹之间分了。
senses.why: If several people are inside one group, anything given to them is distributed inside that group.
senses.whyCN: 如果几个人同在一群里，给他们的东西也就是在这群内部被分掉的。

senses.title: As a member of a group
senses.definition: counted as one member of a larger set or category
senses.definitionCN: 被算作一个更大集合或类别中的一员
senses.example: She is among the few who still speak the old dialect.
senses.exampleCN: 她是少数仍会说这种古老方言的人之一。
senses.why: To be among a group is to be inside its boundary, and membership is exactly that position.
senses.whyCN: 身处一群之中就是在它的边界以内，而「成员身份」正是这个位置。

senses.title: Through the joint action of a group
senses.definition: used when a group acts together without outside help
senses.definitionCN: 用于一群人不借外力、共同做某事的情形
senses.example: Among themselves, the neighbours repaired the damaged lane.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们自己动手修好了受损的小路。
senses.why: The action happens inside the group and stays there, with no one outside taking part.
senses.whyCN: 动作在群体内部发生、也留在群体内部，没有外面的人参与。

senses.title: In comparison with the rest of a group
senses.definition: used to place someone or something in a ranking or comparison within a group
senses.definitionCN: 用于在群体内部作排序或比较时，给某人某物定位
senses.example: He ranks among the best climbers of his generation.
senses.exampleCN: 他跻身同代最好的登山者之列。
senses.why: Ranking needs a set to rank inside, and among supplies that set.
senses.whyCN: 排序需要一个可供排进去的集合，among 提供的正是这个集合。

senses.title: Including some others
senses.definition: in the phrase among others, used to say that the named item is one of several
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 among others，表示所提到的事物只是若干之一
senses.example: The report names several causes, among others the loss of the wetlands.
senses.exampleCN: 报告列举了几个原因，其中包括湿地的消失。
senses.why: The named item is picked out of a larger unnamed group, so the phrase points to a sample inside a set.
senses.whyCN: 被点名的那一项是从一个更大的未列明群体里挑出来的，因此这个短语指向集合内部的一个样本。

intro.en: Among is an Old English phrase that became a single preposition, and its root is the act of mixing.
intro.cn: among 原本是古英语的一个短语，后来凝固成单个介词，它的词根是「混合」这个动作。

items.en: The phrase on gemang meant 'in the mingling, in the crowd'. It joined on 'in' with gemang 'a mingling, an assembly'.
items.cn: 短语 on gemang 意为「在混合之中、在人群里」，由 on「在」与 gemang「混合、聚集」组成。

items.en: Gemang came from mengan 'to mix', the verb behind the modern word mingle.
items.cn: gemang 来自 mengan「混合」，这个动词也是现代词 mingle 的来源。

items.en: The phrase contracted into amonge and among, and the prepositional sense became fixed.
items.cn: 短语缩合为 amonge 与 among，介词义逐渐固定下来。

items.en: The variant amonges appeared, later shortened to amongst; the added -s was an adverbial genitive ending.
items.cn: 十四世纪出现变体 amonges，后来缩为 amongst；附加的 -s 来自副词性属格词尾。

items.en: Among and amongst differ mainly in tone and region, with amongst sounding more formal and more British.
items.cn: among 与 amongst 的差别主要在语气与地域，amongst 听起来更正式、更偏英式。

note.en: The look-alike group is the mixing family and its variant; the near-meaning group gathers prepositions of position and relation.
note.cn: 形近组收「混合」词根的一族词及其变体；近义组收表示位置与关系的介词。

entries.definition: A chiefly British variant of among, used in the same positions.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，among 的英式变体，用法位置相同，语气更正式。

entries.definition: To mix with other people or things; from the same mixing verb behind among.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「混合、交往」，与 among 同出表示「混合」的动词，并非派生关系。

entries.definition: An animal of mixed breed; its first element comes from the same mixing stem.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「混血动物、杂种」，首成分来自同一「混合」词干。

entries.definition: In the middle of something, often a situation or atmosphere rather than a crowd.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「在……之中」，常指处在某种情形或氛围里，而非具体人群。

entries.definition: A more formal variant of amid, common in literary writing.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，amid 的较正式变体，多见于文学作品。

entries.definition: In the space separating two or more distinct things; usually implies separate parties.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「在……之间」，强调彼此分开的两方或多方，与 among 的「混在内部」不同。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English phrase, the mixing verb behind it, and the everyday frames.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的古英语短语、它背后的「混合」动词，以及日常句式。

normal.en: On gemang meant in the mingling: the preposition was once a little phrase.
normal.cn: on gemang 意为「在混合之中」：这个介词原本是一个小短语。

normal.en: Mengan is to mix, and mingle still carries the same picture of people blending.
normal.cn: mengan 是「混合」，mingle 至今仍带着人们混在一起的画面。

normal.en: Among others means the named thing is only one inside a larger set.
normal.cn: among others 意为被点名的事物只是一个更大集合里的一项。

normal.en: Divide something among a group: the thing is cut up inside the group.
normal.cn: 把东西 divide among 一群人，就是在群体内部把它分掉。

normal.en: Among the best ranks someone inside a set; amongst is its more formal British twin.
normal.cn: among the best 把某人排进一个集合里；amongst 是它更正式的英式双胞胎。

abstract.en: Picture a person stepping into a crowd of shoulders, disappearing into the middle of them.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人走进一片肩膀之间，身影没入人群的中央。

abstract.en: Picture five hands meeting over one small pile of coins, the pile shared inside the circle.
abstract.cn: 想象五只手在一小堆硬币上方相聚，那堆钱在圈子内部被分掉。

abstract.en: Picture one tree standing inside a forest, not beside it: the position itself makes it one of the woods.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树站在森林里面而不是旁边：正是这个位置让它成为林子的一部分。

examples.en: The old shepherd walked among the villagers, greeting each of them by name.
examples.cn: 老牧羊人走在村民当中，挨个叫出名字问好。

examples.en: She is among the few who still speak the old dialect.
examples.cn: 她是少数仍会说这种古老方言的人之一。

examples.en: The land was divided among the three families who had farmed it for generations.
examples.cn: 这块地分给了世代耕种它的三户人家。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿蒙」——阿蒙钻进人群里，左右都是肩膀：在……当中

root: 古英语短语 on gemang「在混合之中」由 on「在」与 gemang「混合、聚集」构成，gemang 又来自动词 mengan「混合」，与现代词 mingle 同源。短语后来缩合成介词 among，十四世纪又出现 amonges，再缩为 amongst。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses all place something inside a set: position in the middle, sharing inside the group, membership, joint action, ranking, and a named sample.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项都把某物放进一个集合内部：处于中央的位置、在群体内部分享、成员身份、共同行动、排序定位，以及被点名的样本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person walks into a mingling crowd and is surrounded on all sides.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人走进入群混杂的人群，四周都是人。

branches.en: THE POSITION LINE: the literal place in the middle of a group.
branches.cn: 位置线：字面意义上处在群体中央的位置。

branches.en: THE SHARING LINE: what is given to a group is divided inside it.
branches.cn: 分享线：给一群人的东西在这群内部被分掉。

branches.en: THE MEMBERSHIP LINE: being inside the boundary makes someone one of the group.
branches.cn: 成员线：身处边界以内，就使某人成为这群的一员。

branches.en: THE JOINT ACTION LINE: the group acts from inside itself, with no outside help.
branches.cn: 共同行动线：群体从内部自己动手，不借外力。

branches.en: THE RANKING AND SAMPLE LINE: a set is needed for comparison, and a named item can be drawn out of it.
branches.cn: 排序与举例线：比较需要一个集合，而被点名的一项可以从集合里抽出。

intro.en: Among is a frozen Old English phrase; its parts are ordinary prepositions and a mixing noun, not Latin affixes.
intro.cn: among 是一个凝固的古英语短语，组成部分是普通介词与表示「混合」的名词，并非拉丁词缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin cognate in this family, so the Latin side stays empty rather than borrowing an unrelated word.
latinIntro.cn: 这一词族没有拉丁同源词，因此拉丁部分留空，不借一个无关的词来充数。

items.example: It is the first word of the old phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个古老短语的第一个词。

items.example: The noun supplied the crowd image.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供了「人群」的意象。

items.example: It is the verb behind both gemang and mingle.
items.exampleCN: 它是 gemang 与 mingle 共同的来源动词。

items.meaning: in the middle of a group
items.example: The phrase became one word.
items.exampleCN: 那个短语凝固成了一个词。

items.example: The variant is common in formal writing.
items.exampleCN: 这个变体常见于正式书面语。

items.example: It forms amongst from amonges.
items.exampleCN: 它把 amonges 变成 amongst。

items.example: It keeps the old mixing sense.
items.exampleCN: 它保留了古老的「混合」义。

items.example: Its first element comes from the mixing stem.
items.exampleCN: 它的首成分来自「混合」词干。

definition_zh: 数量；数额；总额；金额；达到（某数量）；等同于
definition_en: a quantity of something, especially money, or the total reached when things are added up; as a verb, to add up to or be equivalent to
core_image: 一堆东西越堆越高，数字沿着刻度一路往上爬
scene: 集市收摊时，摊主把零钱一张张摊在木板上清点。The amount in the tin was just enough to pay for the week's rent.
sceneCN: 这里 amount 是「数额、总数」（第 1 个义项：某物的数量或总和）；句意为铁盒里的钱刚好够付一周的房租。画面里有收摊的木板、摊开的零钱与清点的摊主。

pos.zh: 名词：数量；数额；总额；金额
动词：合计达；等同于；意味着

derivatives.zh: 由本词加介词 to 构成的动词短语，义为「合计达；等同于」
由本词加介词短语构成的正式说法，义为「合计达……之多」，多用于法律与财务文本

senses.title: A quantity of something
senses.definition: how much of something there is, especially when it is uncountable or measured in bulk
senses.definitionCN: 某物有多少，尤指不可数或以整体计量的东西
senses.example: A large amount of rain fell in a single night.
senses.exampleCN: 一夜之间下了大量的雨。
senses.why: The Old French verb meant to go up: as goods are piled or counted, the total climbs, and the climbed total is the amount.
senses.whyCN: 古法语动词意为「向上走」：东西越堆越多、越数越多，总数随之上爬，爬到的那个总数就是 amount。

senses.title: The total of several things
senses.definition: the sum reached when several quantities or costs are added together
senses.definitionCN: 把若干数量或费用相加之后得到的和
senses.example: The final amount on the bill surprised everyone at the table.
senses.exampleCN: 账单上的最终总额让桌旁所有人都吃了一惊。
senses.why: Adding is a way of going up, so the completed addition is named by the same upward movement.
senses.whyCN: 相加就是一种「往上走」，所以加法做完的结果也用同一个「上升」的动作来命名。

senses.title: A sum of money to be paid
senses.definition: a particular sum of money, especially one written on a bill, cheque or account
senses.definitionCN: 特定的一笔钱，尤指写在账单、支票或账户上的数目
senses.example: Please write the amount in words as well as in figures.
senses.exampleCN: 请同时用文字和数字写出金额。
senses.why: Money is the most common thing that gets counted up, so the general total narrows into the figure on a payment.
senses.whyCN: 钱是最常被累加的东西，于是笼统的「总数」收窄成付款单上的那个数字。

senses.title: To add up to a figure
senses.definition: to reach a particular total when everything is counted or added
senses.definitionCN: 把所有项目计入或相加后达到某个总数
senses.example: The repairs amounted to more than the car was worth.
senses.exampleCN: 维修费合计起来超过了这辆车本身的价值。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun into motion: the figures climb until they arrive at a total.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词变成运动：数字一路攀升，直到抵达某个总数。

senses.title: To be equivalent to something
senses.definition: to be equal in effect or meaning to something else, often something unstated
senses.definitionCN: 在效果或含义上等同于另一件事，常指未明说的事
senses.example: His silence amounted to an admission of guilt.
senses.exampleCN: 他的沉默等于承认了过错。
senses.why: If counted together, the facts add up to one conclusion; the total is not money but meaning.
senses.whyCN: 把事实合起来一算，会得出同一个结论；此时的总数不是钱，而是含义。

intro.en: Amount comes from a Latin phrase about climbing a hill, which French turned into a verb of rising totals.
intro.cn: amount 源自一个关于「上山」的拉丁短语，法语把它变成了表示「总数上升」的动词。

items.en: The phrase ad montem meant 'to the mountain, upward', from ad 'to' and mons, montem 'mountain'.
items.cn: 短语 ad montem 意为「向山、向上」，由 ad「向」与 mons、montem「山」构成。

items.en: The phrase contracted into amont, an adverb meaning 'above, upward'.
items.cn: 这个短语缩合成副词 amont，意为「在上方、向上」。

items.en: The verb amonter meant 'to go up, to rise', and in accounts 'to amount to'.
items.cn: 动词 amonter 意为「上升、升高」，在账目语境中意为「合计达」。

items.en: English borrowed the verb and formed the noun amount, first meaning the total that something rises to.
items.cn: 英语借入这个动词，并造出名词 amount，最初指某物累加后达到的总数。

items.en: The money sense became dominant, and the verb specialized into the phrase amount to.
items.cn: 与钱有关的义项成为主流，动词则主要固定在短语 amount to 里。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin image of a mountain; the near-meaning group gathers words for quantities and totals.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「山」的意象；近义组收表示数量与总数的词。

entries.definition: To climb up or increase; also a mountain, from the same Latin source.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「登上、增加」，也可作名词指山，与 amount 同出拉丁语「山」的意象。

entries.definition: A very high hill; from Latin montem, the same word inside the phrase behind amount.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「山」，来自拉丁语 montem，正是 amount 背后那个短语里的词。

entries.definition: Of the highest importance; its second element comes from Old French amont, upward.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「至高无上的、最重要的」，后半部分来自古法语 amont「向上」。

entries.definition: A measurable amount of something, often used in technical or formal contexts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「数量」，指可测量的量，多用于技术或正式语境。

entries.definition: The total of numbers added together, or a quantity of money.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「总数、金额」，指若干数字相加的结果或一笔钱。

entries.definition: The complete figure after everything has been counted.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「总数、合计」，指全部计入后的完整数字。

entries.definition: A count of items, usually countable things rather than bulk material.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「数目」，通常指数得清的物件，而不是成堆的材料。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real Latin hill image, its French descendants, and the money frame the word lives in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的拉丁语「山」意象、它的法语后代，以及这个词所处的金钱语境展开。

normal.en: Ad montem is to the mountain: a total is something you climb up to.
normal.cn: ad montem 是「向山去」：总数就是一路爬上去到达的地方。

normal.en: Amont is upward in Old French, and amonter is to rise; amount keeps that upward motion.
normal.cn: 古法语 amont 是「向上」，amonter 是「上升」，amount 保留了这个向上的动作。

normal.en: Mountain and mount are close relatives from the same Latin word for a hill.
normal.cn: mountain 与 mount 是同族近亲，都来自同一个表示「山」的拉丁词。

normal.en: Amount to is the verb frame: costs amount to a total, facts amount to a conclusion.
normal.cn: amount to 是动词句式：费用合计成一个总数，事实合起来等于一个结论。

normal.en: A bill always shows an amount, which is why the money sense dominates today.
normal.cn: 账单上总有一个 amount，这就是今天与钱有关的义项占主流的原因。

abstract.en: Picture a pile of coins growing taller and taller until it reaches a marked line on the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆硬币越堆越高，直到碰到墙上划好的一道线。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase of numbers, each step a receipt, the top landing the final total.
abstract.cn: 想象一道由数字组成的楼梯，每一级是一张收据，最上面的平台就是最终总额。

abstract.en: Picture a heap of small facts that suddenly tips over into one clear conclusion.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆零散事实忽然倾倒，落成一个清楚的结论。

examples.en: The amount in the tin was just enough to pay for the week's rent.
examples.cn: 铁盒里的钱刚好够付一周的房租。

examples.en: A large amount of rain fell in a single night.
examples.cn: 一夜之间下了大量的雨。

examples.en: His silence amounted to an admission of guilt.
examples.cn: 他的沉默等于承认了过错。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿蒙特」——阿蒙把钱堆成小山，越高越接近总数：数量、总额

root: 拉丁语短语 ad montem「向山、向上」由 ad「向」+ mons、montem「山」构成，缩合为古法语副词 amont「向上」，再派生动词 amonter「上升、合计达」。英语借入动词并造出名词 amount，先指累加达到的总数，后以金额义为主。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses all follow one rising line: a quantity, the completed total, the money figure, the verb of reaching a total, and the moment when facts add up to a meaning.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都沿着同一条上升线：一个数量、加完后的总数、钱上的数字、达到总数的动词，以及事实合起来等于某个含义的那一刻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pile rises toward a marked line, and the line it reaches is the amount.
core.cn: 核心意象：一堆东西朝一道刻度线升高，达到那道线时就是 amount。

branches.en: THE QUANTITY LINE: the bulk itself, before any addition is finished.
branches.cn: 数量线：加法还没做完时，那一堆东西本身的量。

branches.en: THE TOTAL LINE: addition completed, the figure at the top of the climb.
branches.cn: 总数线：加法做完，爬升到顶端的那个数字。

branches.en: THE MONEY LINE: the most countable thing, narrowed to a sum on a bill.
branches.cn: 金额线：最常被累加的钱，收窄成账单上的一个数字。

branches.en: THE VERB LINE: the figures themselves climb to a total.
branches.cn: 动词线：数字自己一路攀升，达到一个总数。

branches.en: THE MEANING LINE: facts added together reach a conclusion rather than a sum of money.
branches.cn: 含义线：事实合起来抵达的是一个结论，而不是一笔钱。

intro.en: Amount is a Latin prepositional phrase that became a French adverb and verb, then an English noun; its parts are not suffixes but direction words.
intro.cn: amount 是一个拉丁介词短语，先变成法语副词与动词，再成为英语名词；它的组成部分不是后缀，而是表示方向的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin ad and mons are recorded words, and the French forms are documented; nothing here is a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ad 与 mons 都是有记录的词，法语形式也有文献可查，这里没有重构形式。

items.example: It points the phrase toward the mountain.
items.exampleCN: 它把这个短语指向山的方向。

items.example: It supplies the upward image of the word.
items.exampleCN: 它提供了这个词「向上」的意象。

items.example: It appears in montem and in mountain.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 montem 与 mountain 中。

items.example: The phrase became this single adverb.
items.exampleCN: 那个短语变成了这个单一副词。

items.meaning: to go up; to amount to
items.example: English took the verb from French.
items.exampleCN: 英语从法语借入了这个动词。

items.example: The borrowed verb produced a new noun.
items.exampleCN: 借入的动词又造出了一个新的名词。

items.meaning: plural or he, she, it form
items.meaningCN: 复数或第三人称单数形式
items.example: It forms amounts.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 amounts。

items.example: It forms amounted.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 amounted。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 mont- 词干经法语进入英语，义为「登上；山」，与 amount 同源
由拉丁语 mont- 词干经法语构成，义为「山」，与 amount 同源

definition_zh: 一个（用于元音开头的单数可数名词前）；每一；某一类；某个
definition_en: the indefinite article used before a singular countable noun beginning with a vowel sound, meaning one, any one, or a certain one
core_image: 手指在众多同类里随意点出一个：不特指哪一个，只点出一个
scene: 旧书摊前，摊主从一叠明信片里抽出一张递给女孩。An old photograph fell out of the book she had just bought.
sceneCN: 这里 an 是不定冠词「一张」（第 1 个义项：在元音开头的单数名词前表示「一个」）；句意为一张旧照片从她刚买的书里掉了出来。画面里有旧书摊、明信片与掉落的照片。

pos.zh: 冠词：不定冠词，用于元音音素开头的单数可数名词前

derivatives.zh: 与本词同出古英语 ān，义为「一」，是同一个数词的另一支
由古英语 ānlic「唯一的」演变而来，义为「仅仅；唯一的」
由古英语 ǣnig「任何一个」演变而来，义为「任何」
由 at + one 合成，义为「赎罪；弥补」，字面是「使成为一体」

senses.title: One, before a vowel sound
senses.titleCN: 一个（用于元音开头的名词前）
senses.definition: the indefinite article used before a singular countable noun that begins with a vowel sound, meaning one unspecified item
senses.definitionCN: 用于以元音音素开头的单数可数名词前的不定冠词，表示一个未特指的事物
senses.example: She bought an orange at the corner stall.
senses.exampleCN: 她在街角的小摊上买了一个橙子。
senses.why: The article is the old word for one, weakened: it still points at a single item, just not a particular one.
senses.whyCN: 这个冠词本是「一」的弱化形式，仍然指向单独一件东西，只是不特指是哪一件。

senses.title: Each, per
senses.definition: used with a unit of time or measure to mean in each one, as in twice an hour
senses.definitionCN: 与时间或计量单位连用，表示「每一」，如 twice an hour
senses.example: The old clock chimes twice an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老钟每小时敲两次。
senses.why: One item of the unit is taken as the standard, and whatever happens is counted against that single unit.
senses.whyCN: 取该单位的一个作为标准，发生的次数都对着这一个单位来计。

senses.title: A member of a class
senses.definition: used before a singular noun to place someone or something in a class or profession
senses.definitionCN: 用于单数名词前，把某人或某物归入某一类别或职业
senses.example: He is an engineer, not a poet.
senses.exampleCN: 他是工程师，不是诗人。
senses.why: Picking one member of a class is enough to represent the class, so the article also classifies.
senses.whyCN: 从一类里挑出一个成员，就足以代表这一类，所以这个冠词也承担分类作用。

senses.title: A certain but unidentified one
senses.definition: used to introduce a person or thing the listener does not yet know
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出一个听者尚不认识的人或物
senses.example: An old friend called me out of the blue.
senses.exampleCN: 一位老朋友忽然给我打了电话。
senses.why: The item is definite to the speaker but unknown to the listener, so it is introduced as one among many.
senses.whyCN: 对说话人来说是确定的，对听者却是未知的，于是以「众多之一」的方式引出来。

senses.title: A kind or degree of something
senses.definition: used with an abstract or mass noun to mean a particular kind or degree of it
senses.definitionCN: 与抽象名词或不可数名词连用，表示其中的某一种或某种程度
senses.example: There was an honesty in her voice that silenced the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她声音里有种诚实，让整个房间安静下来。
senses.why: Counting one instance of a quality turns an abstract mass into a single recognizable kind.
senses.whyCN: 把一种品质数成「一个实例」，就把抽象的整体变成了可辨认的一种。

intro.en: An and one are the same word at two different strengths; the article is simply the weaker twin.
intro.cn: an 与 one 其实是同一个词的强弱两种形态，冠词只是较弱的那一支。

items.en: The numeral ān meant 'one' and could already be used before a noun in the sense 'a certain one'.
items.cn: 数词 ān 意为「一」，早就可以放在名词前，表示「某一个」。

items.en: The form goes back to *ainaz, the common Germanic numeral for one. The form is reconstructed, not directly recorded.
items.cn: 这个词形可追溯到原始日耳曼语 *ainaz，即共同的日耳曼语「一」。该形式属重构，没有直接记录。

items.en: The deeper root is generally reconstructed as *oi-no-, which also underlies Latin ūnus 'one'. The reconstruction is not a recorded word.
items.cn: 更早的词根一般重构为 *oi-no-，拉丁语 ūnus「一」也出自这里。这属于重构形式，不是有记录的词。

items.en: Before a consonant the final -n was lost, giving a; before a vowel it survived as an. The split is phonological, not semantic.
items.cn: 在辅音前词尾 -n 脱落，成为 a；在元音前则保留为 an。这个分化是语音上的，不是意义上的。

items.en: The choice now depends on the first sound, not the first letter: an hour, a university.
items.cn: 今天的选择取决于第一个音素而不是第一个字母：an hour、a university。

note.en: The look-alike group is the numeral family behind the article; the near-meaning group gathers determiners of one-ness and distribution.
note.cn: 形近组收冠词背后的数词家族；近义组收表示「一」与分配的限定词。

entries.definition: The same indefinite article in its consonant-before form.
entries.definitionCN: 冠词，同一个不定冠词在辅音音素前的形式，与 an 是同一词的两个语音变体。

entries.definition: The full numeral for the number 1, from the same Old English ān.
entries.definitionCN: 数词，义为「一」，与 an 同出古英语 ān，是未弱化的完整形式。

entries.definition: Meaning solely or single; historically built from ān plus a suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 副词或形容词，义为「仅仅、唯一的」，历史上由 ān 加后缀构成。

entries.definition: One or some, no matter which; from Old English ǣnig, built on ān.
entries.definitionCN: 限定词，义为「任何」，来自古英语 ǣnig，以 ān 为基础构成。

entries.definition: Every one of two or more considered separately.
entries.definitionCN: 限定词，义为「每一个」，把两个或更多个体逐个看待。

entries.definition: All the members of a group considered one by one.
entries.definitionCN: 限定词，义为「每一个」，把一群成员逐个全部包括进来。

entries.definition: For each; a formal equivalent of the distributive sense of an.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「每」，是 an 分配义的正式对应说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English numeral and the sound rule that still decides between a and an.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的古英语数词，以及至今仍决定用 a 还是 an 的语音规则。

normal.en: An is the weakened form of one: same origin, softer voice.
normal.cn: an 是 one 的弱化形式：来源相同，只是声音更轻。

normal.en: The choice follows the sound: an hour, a university, an honest man.
normal.cn: 选择跟着声音走：an hour、a university、an honest man。

normal.en: Twice an hour uses the distributive sense, one hour taken as the unit.
normal.cn: twice an hour 用的是分配义，把「一个小时」当作单位。

normal.en: Only and any both grew from the same numeral ān.
normal.cn: only 与 any 都从同一个数词 ān 长出来。

normal.en: Atone is literally at one: to be at one again is to make up for a wrong.
normal.cn: atone 字面是 at one：重新合而为一，就是为过错作弥补。

abstract.en: Picture a hand hovering over a bowl of fruit and picking one without choosing which kind.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在一碗水果上方悬着，随手拿起一个，并不挑是哪种。

abstract.en: Picture a single lantern lit in a long row of unlit ones: the row is the class, the lit one is the article's pick.
abstract.cn: 想象一长排未点的灯里亮起一盏：整排是类别，亮起的那盏就是冠词挑出的那一个。

abstract.en: Picture the letter n sliding off the front of one before a consonant, leaving a behind.
abstract.cn: 想象字母 n 在辅音前从 one 的前面滑落，留下一个 a。

examples.en: An old photograph fell out of the book she had just bought.
examples.cn: 一张旧照片从她刚买的书里掉了出来。

examples.en: He is an engineer, not a poet.
examples.cn: 他是工程师，不是诗人。

examples.en: The old clock chimes twice an hour.
examples.cn: 那座老钟每小时敲两次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安」——安安静静点出一个，不挑哪一个：一个

root: 古英语数词 ān「一」是 an 与 one 的共同来源，可追溯到原始日耳曼语 *ainaz；更早的印欧词根一般重构为 *oi-no-，拉丁语 ūnus「一」也出自这里。辅音前词尾 -n 脱落成 a，元音前保留为 an，分化纯属语音。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses of one small word: a single unspecified item, a unit taken for rate, a class member, an unknown person, and one instance of a quality.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个小词的五种用法：一个未特指的事物、被当作单位的一个、一个类别的成员、一个未知的人，以及某种品质的一个实例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger points at one item among many similar ones, without saying which.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指在许多同类中点出一个，却不说明是哪一个。

branches.en: THE SINGLE ITEM LINE: the plain indefinite article before a vowel sound.
branches.cn: 单件线：元音音素前最普通的不定冠词用法。

branches.en: THE UNIT LINE: one unit of time or measure used as the standard for a rate.
branches.cn: 单位线：把一个时间或计量单位当作比率的标准。

branches.en: THE CLASS LINE: one member stands for a whole profession or category.
branches.cn: 类别线：一个成员代表整个职业或类别。

branches.en: THE UNKNOWN LINE: a definite person is introduced as one the listener cannot identify.
branches.cn: 未知线：对说话人确定的人，以听者无法指认的方式引出。

branches.en: THE INSTANCE LINE: an abstract quality is counted as one recognizable kind.
branches.cn: 实例线：抽象品质被数成可辨认的一种。

intro.en: An has no affixes of its own; its construction history is the weakening of a numeral and the survival of two sound shapes.
intro.cn: an 本身没有词缀；它的构词史是一个数词的弱化，以及两种语音形态的并存。

latinIntro.en: Latin ūnus is a genuine distant cognate through the reconstructed Indo-European root, not a borrowing into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ūnus 通过重构的印欧词根与它是远亲，并不是借入英语的词。

items.example: It is the recorded source of both an and one.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录可查的源头，an 与 one 都出自它。

items.example: This form is reconstructed, not directly attested.
items.exampleCN: 这个形式是重构的，没有直接文献证据。

items.example: It is the same article with the final nasal lost.
items.exampleCN: 它是同一个冠词丢掉词尾鼻音后的形式。

items.example: It keeps the full form of ān.
items.exampleCN: 它保留了 ān 的完整形式。

items.example: It is the base of modern only.
items.exampleCN: 它是现代词 only 的基础。

items.example: It is the base of modern any.
items.exampleCN: 它是现代词 any 的基础。

items.example: It forms ānlic from ān.
items.exampleCN: 它把 ān 构成 ānlic。

items.example: It forms ǣnig from ān.
items.exampleCN: 它把 ān 构成 ǣnig。

derivatives.zh: 与 an 同出古英语 ān，义为「一」，是未弱化的形式
由古英语 ānlic 演变，义为「仅仅；唯一的」
由古英语 ǣnig 演变，义为「任何」

definition_zh: 分析；分解；化验；解析；进行精神分析
definition_en: to examine something by breaking it into its parts, especially to understand its structure, composition or meaning
core_image: 把一团缠结的线慢慢拆开，露出一根根单独的线头
scene: 实验室的灯亮到深夜，桌上一排试管贴着标签，记录本摊开着。The team analysed the water from six wells before making any recommendation.
sceneCN: 这里 analysed 是「分析化验」（第 1 个义项：把整体拆开来研究）；句意为小组在提出任何建议之前，先分析了六口井的水。画面里有深夜的实验室、贴标签的试管与摊开的记录本。

pos.zh: 动词：分析；分解；化验；解析；进行精神分析

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语名词 analysis 借入，义为「分析；分析结果」，与动词同源
由 analysis 加 -ist 构成，义为「分析师；化验员」
由希腊语 analytikos 借入，义为「分析的；解析的」
由 analytic 加 -al 构成，义为「善于分析的；分析性的」
由 analytical 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「以分析的方式」

senses.title: To break a whole into parts
senses.definition: to examine something complex by separating it into its parts and studying how they fit together
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂事物拆成各个部分，研究它们如何组合，从而弄清整体
senses.example: Researchers analysed the survey data for three months.
senses.exampleCN: 研究人员花了三个月分析调查数据。
senses.why: Greek analyein is to loosen up: the whole is untied into its parts so that each can be seen.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 analyein 是「松开」：把整体解开成各个部分，好让每一部分都看得见。

senses.title: To test the composition of a substance
senses.definition: to test a substance in a laboratory to find out what it contains
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室检验某物质，查明其中含有什么成分
senses.example: The lab analysed the soil for traces of lead.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室分析了土壤，查找铅的痕迹。
senses.why: Chemical analysis separates a substance into its elements, which is the loosening image made literal.
senses.whyCN: 化学分析把物质分离成元素，正是「拆开」这个意象的字面实现。

senses.title: To parse a sentence
senses.definition: to describe the grammatical structure of a sentence by identifying its parts
senses.definitionCN: 识别句子的各个成分，说明其语法结构
senses.example: Students analysed the sentence clause by clause.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们一个从句一个从句地解析这个句子。
senses.why: Grammar treats a sentence as a built object, and analysis takes it apart to show the joints.
senses.whyCN: 语法把句子当作一个搭建起来的物件，分析就是把它拆开，露出接缝。

senses.title: To practise psychoanalysis
senses.definition: to treat a patient by exploring unconscious thoughts and feelings over a series of sessions
senses.definitionCN: 通过一系列会谈探究病人的潜意识想法与情感，以此治疗
senses.example: The therapist analysed the patient's dreams over several sessions.
senses.exampleCN: 治疗师在几次会谈中分析了病人的梦。
senses.why: The mind is treated as a layered structure, and therapy loosens the layers to reach what lies underneath.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被当作有层次的结构，治疗就是把层层结构松开，抵达藏在下面的东西。

senses.title: To assess a situation or market
senses.definition: to study a situation, market or strategy systematically in order to judge it or plan action
senses.definitionCN: 系统地研究局势、市场或策略，以便作出判断或制定行动
senses.example: Analysts analysed the market carefully before the merger was announced.
senses.exampleCN: 合并宣布之前，分析师们仔细分析了市场。
senses.why: A market is a complex whole of prices, buyers and risks; breaking it into factors is how a decision is prepared.
senses.whyCN: 市场是价格、买家与风险构成的复杂整体；把它拆成若干因素，正是为决策做准备。

intro.en: Analyse is a Greek verb of loosening that came to English through Latin and French, and its spelling still divides the Atlantic.
intro.cn: analyse 是一个表示「松开」的希腊动词，经拉丁语与法语进入英语，它的拼写至今仍横跨大西洋两岸。

items.en: The verb lyein meant 'to loosen, release, untie'. It is the root of a large family of Greek words.
items.cn: 动词 lyein 意为「松开、释放、解开」，是希腊语一大族词的词根。

items.en: Ana- 'up, throughout' plus lyein formed analyein, 'to loosen up, undo, resolve into elements'.
items.cn: 前缀 ana-「向上、彻底」与 lyein 构成 analyein，意为「松开、拆解、分解成元素」。

items.en: The noun analysis meant 'a dissolving, a resolution', especially of a complex whole into its parts.
items.cn: 名词 analysis 意为「分解、解析」，尤指把复杂整体拆成部分。

items.en: Latin analysis carried the Greek noun into learned use, and the Latin adjective analyticus followed.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 analysis 把这个希腊名词带入学术语言，拉丁形容词 analyticus 也随之出现。

items.en: English borrowed the noun in the seventeenth century and formed the verb; early scientific use was close to chemical separation.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入名词并造出动词；早期科学用法接近化学分离。

items.en: British writing keeps analyse and analyser, while American writing uses analyze and analyzer. The pronunciation follows the spelling.
items.cn: 英式写作保留 analyse 与 analyser，美式写作使用 analyze 与 analyzer，读音随拼写而变。

note.en: The look-alike group is the same Greek family and the American spelling; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of close examination.
note.cn: 形近组收同一希腊词族的成员及美式拼写；近义组收表示仔细检查的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for the process or result of breaking something into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「分析、分析结果」，指拆解整体的过程或结果。

entries.definition: A person who performs analysis, especially of data or finance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「分析师」，指从事分析工作的人，尤指数据或金融领域。

entries.definition: Adjective: relating to analysis or proceeding by separating parts.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「分析的、解析的」，指与拆解研究有关的。

entries.definition: The American spelling and pronunciation of the same verb.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个动词的美式拼写与读音，与 analyse 完全同义。

entries.definition: To look at something closely and carefully, often without taking it apart.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「检查、审视」，强调仔细看，未必拆解。

entries.definition: To judge the value or quality of something after study.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「评估」，指研究之后判断其价值或质量。

entries.definition: To cut something apart in order to study its structure, literally or figuratively.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「解剖、仔细剖析」，字面或比喻上都强调切开来看。

entries.definition: To explain the meaning of something, rather than its structure.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「解释、诠释」，侧重说明含义而不是拆解结构。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Greek loosening root and the spelling split that still marks British and American usage.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的希腊语「松开」词根，以及至今区分英美用法的拼写差异。

normal.en: lyein is to loosen; analysis is the act of loosening a whole into parts.
normal.cn: lyein 是「松开」；analysis 就是把整体松开成部分。

normal.en: ana- means up or throughout, so analyein is to loosen something all the way through.
normal.cn: ana- 表示「向上、彻底」，所以 analyein 是把东西彻底松开。

normal.en: Chemistry made the metaphor literal: analysis separates a substance into its elements.
normal.cn: 化学把这个比喻变成字面：分析把物质分离成元素。

normal.en: The British verb is analyse, the American analyze; both come from the same noun.
normal.cn: 英式动词是 analyse，美式是 analyze，两者都来自同一个名词。

normal.en: Analyst adds -ist to analysis: the person who does the loosening.
normal.cn: analyst 在 analysis 后加 -ist：做「拆解」这件事的人。

abstract.en: Picture a knotted ball of string slowly unwinding until every strand lies separate on the table.
abstract.cn: 想象一团打了结的线慢慢解开，直到每一根都单独躺在桌上。

abstract.en: Picture a watch opened on a cloth, each gear placed in a row so the movement can be understood.
abstract.cn: 想象一只表在布上被打开，每个齿轮排成一行，好让人看懂它怎么走。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence drawn as a diagram, its clauses branching like a tree turned upside down.
abstract.cn: 想象一个句子被画成图解，各从句像一棵倒过来的树那样分叉。

examples.en: The team analysed the water from six wells before making any recommendation.
examples.cn: 小组在提出任何建议之前，先分析了六口井的水。

examples.en: Students analysed the sentence clause by clause.
examples.cn: 学生们一个从句一个从句地解析这个句子。

examples.en: Analysts analysed the market carefully before the merger was announced.
examples.cn: 合并宣布之前，分析师们仔细分析了市场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿拉来撕」——把整团线一根根撕开来看：分析、分解

root: 希腊语动词 lyein「松开」加前缀 ana-「向上、彻底」构成 analyein「拆解」，其名词 analysis「分解」经中世纪拉丁语进入学术语言，再由法语进入英语。英式拼写 analyse，美式拼写 analyze，同源同义。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses apply the same loosening motion to data, to substances, to sentences, to the mind, and to markets.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项把同一个「拆开」的动作分别用到数据、物质、句子、心灵与市场上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a knotted tangle is untied until every separate strand is visible.
core.cn: 核心意象：一团打结的缠结被解开，直到每一根线都看得见。

branches.en: THE STRUCTURE LINE: a complex whole is taken apart to see how it is built.
branches.cn: 结构线：把复杂整体拆开，看清它是怎么搭起来的。

branches.en: THE SUBSTANCE LINE: chemical testing makes the loosening literal.
branches.cn: 物质线：化学检验把「拆开」变成字面动作。

branches.en: THE SENTENCE LINE: grammar opens a sentence at its joints.
branches.cn: 句子线：语法在句子的接缝处把它打开。

branches.en: THE MIND LINE: therapy loosens the layers of the unconscious.
branches.cn: 心灵线：治疗把潜意识的层次松开。

branches.en: THE DECISION LINE: a market is split into factors so that a judgment can be made.
branches.cn: 决策线：把市场拆成若干因素，以便作出判断。

intro.en: Analyse is built from a Greek prefix, a Greek loosening verb and a noun suffix; English adds its own spelling variants.
intro.cn: analyse 由希腊前缀、表示「松开」的希腊动词与名词后缀构成；英语又加入了自身的拼写变体。

definition_zh: 分析；分析结果；化验；解析；精神分析；数学分析
definition_en: the process or result of separating something complex into its parts in order to understand it
core_image: 散开的零件按顺序摆回桌面，每一件的位置都看得清楚
scene: 会议室的白板上写满箭头与圈，几个人围着长桌争论数据的走向。Her analysis of the sales figures showed where the losses had begun.
sceneCN: 这里 analysis 是「分析结果」（第 1 个义项：把整体拆开研究的过程与结论）；句意为她对销售数字的分析指出了亏损从何处开始。画面里有白板、箭头与围着长桌讨论的人。

pos.zh: 名词：分析；分析结果；化验；解析；精神分析；数学分析

derivatives.zh: 由同一希腊词族经法语进入英语的动词，义为「分析；化验」
由本词加后缀 -ist 构成，义为「分析师；化验员」
由希腊形容词词干加 -al 构成，义为「分析的；善于分析的」
由 analytical 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「以分析的方式」

senses.title: The process of separating a whole
senses.definition: the process of examining something complex by separating it into its parts
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂事物拆成各个部分来考察的过程
senses.example: The analysis took longer than the experiment itself.
senses.exampleCN: 分析所用的时间比实验本身还长。
senses.why: Greek analysis is a loosening: the name belongs first to the act of untying the whole.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 analysis 是「松开」，这个名字首先属于把整体解开的那件事。

senses.title: The result or written account
senses.definition: the conclusions or written account produced by such an examination
senses.definitionCN: 这种考察所得出的结论或写成的报告
senses.example: Her analysis of the sales figures showed where the losses had begun.
senses.exampleCN: 她对销售数字的分析指出了亏损从何处开始。
senses.why: The act produces a result, and the result takes the same name as the act.
senses.whyCN: 动作产生了结果，结果就沿用了动作的名字。

senses.title: Chemical testing of a substance
senses.definition: a laboratory test that identifies the components of a substance
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室检验某物质的组成成分
senses.example: A chemical analysis revealed traces of salt in the well.
senses.exampleCN: 化学分析显示井水中有盐的痕迹。
senses.why: Chemistry performs the loosening in a literal way, separating a sample into measurable components.
senses.whyCN: 化学以字面方式完成这种「拆开」，把样本分离成可测量的成分。

senses.title: A branch of mathematics
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics dealing with limits, continuity, derivatives and integrals
senses.definitionCN: 研究极限、连续性、导数与积分的数学分支
senses.example: Calculus is the first course in mathematical analysis for many students.
senses.exampleCN: 对许多学生来说，微积分是数学分析的第一门课。
senses.why: Mathematics resolves a complex function into simpler limiting parts, so the field takes the name of the resolving act.
senses.whyCN: 数学把复杂函数拆解成更简单的极限部分，因此这个领域沿用了「拆解」的名字。

senses.title: A course of psychoanalysis
senses.definition: a long course of treatment that explores unconscious thoughts and feelings
senses.definitionCN: 长期探究潜意识想法与情感的治疗过程
senses.example: He began an analysis with a therapist after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 事故之后，他开始接受一位治疗师的精神分析。
senses.why: The mind is treated as a layered whole, and the treatment loosens those layers over time.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被当作有层次的整体，治疗则用较长时间把这些层次一层层松开。

senses.title: Grammatical parsing
senses.definition: the description of a sentence by identifying its grammatical parts
senses.definitionCN: 通过识别语法成分来描述一个句子
senses.example: A grammatical analysis of the poem opened the lecture.
senses.exampleCN: 讲座以对这首诗的语法分析开场。
senses.why: A sentence is a built structure, and grammatical analysis shows its joints in order.
senses.whyCN: 句子是搭建起来的结构，语法分析按顺序展示它的接缝。

intro.en: Analysis is the noun that came first; the English verb was formed from it, not the other way round.
intro.cn: analysis 是先出现的名词，英语动词是由它造出来的，而不是反过来。

items.en: Lyein meant 'to loosen, untie', the root of a large learned family.
items.cn: lyein 意为「松开、解开」，是一大族学术词汇的词根。

items.en: Ana- 'up, throughout' plus lyein gave analyein, 'to loosen up, resolve into parts'.
items.cn: ana-「向上、彻底」加 lyein 得到 analyein，意为「松开、分解成部分」。

items.en: The noun analysis named 'a dissolving, a resolution', especially of a complex whole.
items.cn: 名词 analysis 指「分解、解析」，尤指复杂整体的拆解。

items.en: Medieval Latin adopted the Greek noun in learned and later scientific writing.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语在学术与后来的科学写作中采用了这个希腊名词。

items.en: English borrowed analysis first as a learned noun; the verb analyse followed by back-formation. Exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 英语先借入名词 analysis 作为学术用词，动词 analyse 随后由它反推而成；确切年代不确定。

items.en: The plural analyses keeps the Greek pattern, and the word now covers chemistry, grammar, mathematics and therapy.
items.cn: 复数 analyses 保留希腊语变化方式，这个词今天覆盖化学、语法、数学与心理治疗。

note.en: The look-alike group is the same family with its spelling variants; the near-meaning group gathers formal studies and summaries.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词族及其拼写变体；近义组收正式的研究与综述类词。

entries.definition: The British verb formed from the noun; American spelling is analyze.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，英式拼写 analyse，美式拼写 analyze，由本名词反推而成。

entries.definition: A person who carries out analysis, especially in finance or data work.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「分析师」，指从事分析工作的人，多用于金融或数据领域。

entries.definition: Adjective: using or showing careful analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「分析的、善于分析的」，指做事有条理地拆解研究。

entries.definition: The systematic computational analysis of data, used as a plural noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「数据分析学、分析技术」，指对数据的系统计算分析。

entries.definition: A careful look or investigation, not necessarily a formal separation into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「检查、审查」，强调仔细查看，未必拆成部分。

entries.definition: A careful piece of research on a subject; broader and less technical than analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「研究」，指对某课题的仔细探讨，范围更宽，技术性较弱。

entries.definition: A division of information into categories, often for practical display.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「分类细目、分解」，常指为展示方便而把信息分门别类。

entries.definition: A general survey or assessment rather than a detailed structural separation.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「回顾、评述」，偏总体评估，而不是细致的结构拆解。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Greek noun, its irregular plural, and the scientific fields that borrowed it.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的希腊名词、它不规则的复数，以及借用它的各个科学领域。

normal.en: The plural is analyses: the Greek -is becomes -es, just as in crisis and crises.
normal.cn: 复数是 analyses：希腊语 -is 变 -es，正如 crisis 变 crises。

normal.en: The noun came before the verb; English made analyse from analysis.
normal.cn: 名词先出现，英语是从 analysis 造出 analyse 的。

normal.en: Chemical analysis separates a sample; mathematical analysis separates a function into limits.
normal.cn: 化学分析把样本分离，数学分析把函数拆成极限。

normal.en: In the final analysis is a fixed phrase meaning after everything is weighed.
normal.cn: in the final analysis 是固定短语，意为「把所有因素权衡之后」。

normal.en: Analyst and analytics both grow from this noun, one a person, one a field.
normal.cn: analyst 与 analytics 都由这个名词长出，一个指人，一个指领域。

abstract.en: Picture a machine taken apart on a cloth, every part in a neat row, the whole readable at a glance.
abstract.cn: 想象一台机器在布上被拆开，每个零件排成整齐一行，整体一眼就能看懂。

abstract.en: Picture a map with layers peeled apart: roads on one sheet, rivers on another, hills on a third.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图被分成几层：道路在一张上，河流在另一张上，山丘在第三张上。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence laid out like a skeleton, its joints labelled one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一个句子被摆成一副骨架，每一处关节都逐一标出名字。

examples.en: Her analysis of the sales figures showed where the losses had begun.
examples.cn: 她对销售数字的分析指出了亏损从何处开始。

examples.en: A chemical analysis revealed traces of salt in the well.
examples.cn: 化学分析显示井水中有盐的痕迹。

examples.en: In the final analysis, the cheaper plan was also the slower one.
examples.cn: 归根结底，更便宜的那个方案也是更慢的那个。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses share one noun of separation: the act, its result, chemical testing, a mathematical field, a therapy, and a grammatical description.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项共享同一个「拆解」名词：动作本身、动作的结果、化学化验、数学分支、一种治疗，以及语法描述。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole lies in pieces on a table, each piece in its place and the structure finally visible.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个整体在桌上散成零件，每件各就其位，结构终于看清。

branches.en: THE ACT LINE: the process of taking a complex whole apart.
branches.cn: 动作线：把复杂整体拆开的过程。

branches.en: THE RESULT LINE: the conclusions or report produced by the act.
branches.cn: 结果线：动作产生的结论或报告。

branches.en: THE LABORATORY LINE: chemical analysis makes separation physical.
branches.cn: 实验室线：化学分析让「分离」成为物理动作。

branches.en: THE FORMAL LINES: mathematics and grammar each take a structure apart by rule.
branches.cn: 形式线：数学与语法各自按规则拆解一种结构。

branches.en: THE MIND LINE: psychoanalysis loosens the layers of the unconscious.
branches.cn: 心灵线：精神分析把潜意识的层次松开。

senses.title: A finance or business analyst
senses.definition: a professional who studies market data, accounts or business performance and gives judgments or forecasts
senses.definitionCN: 研究市场数据、账目或经营表现并作出判断或预测的专业人士
senses.example: The analyst stayed late to explain why the share price had fallen.
senses.exampleCN: 这位分析师留下来解释股价为何下跌。
senses.why: Finance reduces a company to figures, and someone must loosen those figures into trends, so the person takes the noun of the act.
senses.whyCN: 金融把一家公司化成一堆数字，需要有人把这些数字拆成趋势，于是做这件事的人沿用了「分析」这个名词。

senses.title: A laboratory analyst
senses.definition: a person who tests samples in a laboratory and reports what they contain
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室检验样本并报告其成分的人
senses.example: The analyst found traces of copper in the river sample.
senses.exampleCN: 化验员在河水样本中发现了微量铜。
senses.why: Chemical work is the oldest literal kind of analysis, so the job title keeps the laboratory image.
senses.whyCN: 化学工作是最古老的字面「分析」，因此这个职称保留了实验室的意象。

senses.title: A systems analyst
senses.definition: a person who studies how a computer or business system works and designs improvements
senses.definitionCN: 研究计算机或业务系统如何运作并设计改进方案的人
senses.example: A systems analyst mapped the old records system before replacing it.
senses.exampleCN: 一位系统分析师在替换旧档案系统之前，先把它梳理清楚。
senses.why: A system is a complex whole of components, and this job is to take it apart before rebuilding.
senses.whyCN: 系统是由部件构成的复杂整体，这份工作就是在重建之前先把它拆开看。

senses.title: A psychoanalyst
senses.definition: a therapist trained to explore a patient's unconscious thoughts and feelings
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练、探究病人潜意识想法与情感的治疗师
senses.example: Her analyst helped her trace the fear back to childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 她的精神分析师帮她把这种恐惧追溯到童年。
senses.why: The mind is treated as layered, and this profession loosens the layers rather than measuring them.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被当作有层次的结构，这个职业做的是把层次松开，而不是去测量它。

senses.title: A commentator who explains events
senses.definition: a journalist or observer who explains political or social events by separating causes and effects
senses.definitionCN: 通过区分原因与结果来解释政治或社会事件的记者或观察者
senses.example: One political analyst described the vote as a quiet warning.
senses.exampleCN: 一位政治评论分析员把这次投票称作一次无声的警告。
senses.why: Public events are tangled, and an analyst untangles them into causes, motives and likely outcomes.
senses.whyCN: 公共事件是一团缠结，分析者把它拆成原因、动机与可能的后果。

intro.en: Analyst is a French coinage from the Greek noun for analysis, and the word spread as analysis spread into new fields.
intro.cn: analyst 是法语用希腊语「分析」名词造出的词，随着分析进入各个领域而扩散。

items.en: Greek analysis meant 'a dissolving, a resolution into parts', from analyein 'to loosen up'.
items.cn: 希腊语 analysis 意为「分解、解析成部分」，来自 analyein「松开」。

items.en: French formed analyste from analyse plus the person suffix -iste; the word named someone skilled in analysis.
items.cn: 法语用 analyse 加表示人的后缀 -iste 造出 analyste，指擅长分析的人。

items.en: English borrowed the French word; the early use was learned and often mathematical. The exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语借入这个法语词；早期用法偏学术，常与数学相关，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Chemistry and psychoanalysis gave the word two strong professional homes: the laboratory analyst and the analyst on the couch.
items.cn: 化学与精神分析给了这个词两个稳固的职业归属：实验室化验员，以及躺在诊椅旁的分析师。

items.en: Finance, computing and journalism added finance analyst, systems analyst and political analyst to the family.
items.cn: 金融、计算机与新闻业又加入金融分析师、系统分析师与政治评论分析员。

note.en: The look-alike group is the analysis family; the near-meaning group gathers people who study and explain rather than separate parts.
note.cn: 形近组收 analysis 这一词族；近义组收研究与解释类职业，侧重说明而非拆解。

entries.definition: The noun for the act or result of separating something into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「分析；分析结果」，指拆解整体的动作或结论。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to examine something by breaking it into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「分析；化验」，指把整体拆开来研究。

entries.definition: Adjective: characterized by careful separation and reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「分析的；善于分析的」，指有条理地拆解与推理。

entries.definition: The field of computational data analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「数据分析学」，指用计算手段分析数据的领域。

entries.definition: Someone with special knowledge; broader than analyst and not tied to any method.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「专家」，指具有专门知识的人，范围比 analyst 更宽，不限定方法。

entries.definition: A person who explains and judges events for an audience, often in media.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「评论员」，指向公众解释与评断事件的人，多见于媒体。

entries.definition: A person who investigates a subject systematically, often producing new data.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「研究者」，指系统探究某课题的人，常亲自产出新数据。

entries.definition: Someone who watches events closely and reports what they see, without formal analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「观察者」，指密切注视事件并报告所见的人，未必做正式分析。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the French person suffix and the three professional homes the word acquired.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用法语中表示人的后缀，以及这个词后来获得的三个职业归属。

normal.en: Analysis plus -ist: the person who performs the loosening.
normal.cn: analysis 加 -ist：做「拆解」这件事的人。

normal.en: French -iste is the same suffix that gives artist and dentist.
normal.cn: 法语 -iste 也是构成 artist 与 dentist 的那个后缀。

normal.en: The lab analyst tests a sample; the finance analyst tests a company.
normal.cn: 实验室分析师检验样本，金融分析师检验一家公司。

normal.en: Systems analyst takes a system apart before rebuilding it.
normal.cn: 系统分析师在重建之前先把系统拆开。

normal.en: Political analyst separates causes from results for the public.
normal.cn: 政治评论分析员替公众把原因与结果分开。

abstract.en: Picture a person at a long table covered with printouts, one finger tracing a line that nobody else noticed.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人坐在长桌前，桌上铺满打印稿，一根手指沿着别人没注意到的曲线移动。

abstract.en: Picture a translator between numbers and people: the numbers speak first, the analyst says what they mean.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在数字与人之间做翻译：数字先说话，分析师说出它们的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass held over a map that looks ordinary until a route appears under it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只放大镜压在一张看似普通的地图上，直到一条路线在镜下滑现。

examples.en: The analyst stayed late to explain why the share price had fallen.
examples.cn: 这位分析师留下来解释股价为何下跌。

examples.en: The analyst found traces of copper in the river sample.
examples.cn: 化验员在河水样本中发现了微量铜。

examples.en: One political analyst described the vote as a quiet warning.
examples.cn: 一位政治评论分析员把这次投票称作一次无声的警告。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses are one job title spreading through five workplaces: finance, the laboratory, computing, the therapy room, and the news desk.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项是同一个职称扩散到五个工作场所：金融、实验室、计算机、治疗室与新闻台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person holds a magnifying glass over a table of figures and points out the hidden line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人拿着放大镜俯看成堆数字，指出别人看不见的那条线。

branches.en: THE MARKET LINE: figures become trends, and the analyst explains the movement of prices.
branches.cn: 市场线：数字变成趋势，分析师解释价格的走向。

branches.en: THE LABORATORY LINE: a sample is separated into measurable components.
branches.cn: 实验室线：样本被分离成可测量的成分。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM LINE: a complex machine or process is mapped before it is rebuilt.
branches.cn: 系统线：复杂的机器或流程在重建之前先被梳理清楚。

branches.en: THE MIND LINE: the therapist loosens the layers of the unconscious.
branches.cn: 心灵线：治疗师把潜意识的层次松开。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC LINE: events are untangled for an audience into causes and outcomes.
branches.cn: 公众线：替听众把事件拆成原因与结果。

intro.cn: analyst 是希腊语 analysis 名词加法语表示人的后缀 -ist；词族其余成员保留 analytic 词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin analysis and analyticus are documented Greek borrowings, and the French analyste is recorded, so nothing here is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 analysis 与 analyticus 是有文献的希腊借词，法语 analyste 也有记录，因此这里没有重构形式。
