senses.title: To make someone slightly angry
senses.definition: to cause mild anger or irritation, usually through repeated small actions
senses.definitionCN: 通常因反复的小动作而引起轻微恼怒或不耐烦
senses.example: The repeated rustling began to annoy everyone at the long table.
senses.exampleCN: 反复的窸窣声开始让长桌旁所有人都心烦。
senses.why: The French source meant to trouble and weary; annoyance is a wearing-down rather than a blow.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源意为「使人烦扰、使厌倦」；annoy 是一种慢慢磨损，而不是一记重击。

senses.title: To pester or bother repeatedly
senses.definition: to keep disturbing someone with requests or unwanted attention
senses.definitionCN: 不断以请求或不必要的关注打扰某人
senses.example: The boy annoyed his sister until she gave him the book.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩一直缠着姐姐，直到她把书给了他。
senses.why: When the same small disturbance repeats, the irritation compounds and the verb takes on the idea of pestering.
senses.whyCN: 同一个小的干扰反复出现，烦躁就会叠加，动词于是带上「纠缠」的意思。

senses.title: To cause physical discomfort
senses.definition: in older use, to trouble or hurt a part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 较旧的用法，指使身体某部位不适或疼痛
senses.example: The tight band annoyed the wound and had to be loosened.
senses.exampleCN: 绷带勒得伤口不适，只好把它放松。
senses.why: The original sense was broad trouble, so physical discomfort was included before the word narrowed to mild anger.
senses.whyCN: 最初的词义是广义的「烦扰」，因此在收窄为「轻微发怒」之前也包括身体上的不适。

senses.title: To feel irritated, in the passive
senses.definition: in the passive frames be annoyed at or be annoyed with, to feel irritated by something or someone
senses.definitionCN: 用于被动结构 be annoyed at 或 be annoyed with，表示因某事或某人而感到恼火
senses.example: She was annoyed with herself for forgetting the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 她因为忘了会议而生自己的气。
senses.why: The passive puts the person on the receiving end: the disturbance acts, and the person is annoyed.
senses.whyCN: 被动结构让人处在承受的一端：干扰在施加，人是被烦到的一方。

intro.en: Annoy began as a Latin phrase about hatred, passed through French, and softened into mild irritation.
intro.cn: annoy 起初是一个关于「憎恨」的拉丁短语，经法语传入后逐渐软化为轻微的恼怒。

items.en: The phrase in odio meant 'in hatred', from odium 'hatred'. To have someone in hatred was to regard them with hostility.
items.cn: 短语 in odio 意为「在憎恨之中」，来自 odium「憎恨」。把某人「置于憎恨里」，就是以敌意对待他。

items.en: The verb enuier meant 'to trouble, to vex, to weary', carrying the Latin phrase into everyday emotional life.
items.cn: 动词 enuier 意为「使烦扰、使烦恼、使厌倦」，把那个拉丁短语带入日常情感生活。

items.en: The noun enui meant 'trouble, annoyance'; it later became English ennui, a deep boredom.
items.cn: 名词 enui 意为「烦扰、烦恼」，后来还变成英语的 ennui，指深层的倦怠无聊。

items.en: English borrowed the verb as annoy, first in the strong sense of harming or troubling. The exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语把动词借入为 annoy，起初是「伤害、烦扰」的强义；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The sense weakens to mild irritation, and the passive frames be annoyed at and be annoyed with become standard.
items.cn: 词义弱化为轻微的恼怒，被动搭配 be annoyed at 与 be annoyed with 成为标准用法。

note.en: The look-alike group is the annoyance family plus its French cousin ennui; the near-meaning group ranks ways of disturbing someone.
note.cn: 形近组收 annoyance 词族及其法语表亲 ennui；近义组按打扰方式排列。

entries.definition: The feeling of being irritated, or the thing that causes it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「烦恼」或「恼人的事」，指被惹恼的感受或引发这种感受的东西。

entries.definition: Adjective: feeling mild anger or irritation.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「感到恼火的」，指人处在轻微愤怒之中。

entries.definition: Adjective: causing irritation.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「令人恼火的」，指某事物引起烦躁。

entries.definition: Deep boredom and listlessness, borrowed from French from the same Latin phrase in odio.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「倦怠、无聊」，借自法语，与 annoy 同出拉丁短语 in odio。

entries.definition: To make someone mildly angry, often through a physical or repeated trigger.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「激怒、使恼火」，常由身体刺激或反复的触发引起。

entries.definition: To disturb or trouble someone; broader and often gentler than annoy.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「打扰、烦扰」，范围更宽，语气常比 annoy 轻。

entries.definition: To annoy repeatedly with requests or questions.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「纠缠、不断烦扰」，指以请求或问题反复打扰。

entries.definition: Informal: to annoy or bother someone with repeated demands.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，口语义为「烦扰、找麻烦」，指以反复要求给人添麻烦。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin hatred phrase and the passive frames that now carry the feeling.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语「憎恨」短语，以及今天承载这种感受的被动句式。

normal.en: In odio is in hatred: annoy started as putting someone in a hated place.
normal.cn: in odio 是「在憎恨中」：annoy 起初是把某人放进被憎恨的位置。

normal.en: Ennui is the same French noun at a deeper level: annoyance can grow into boredom.
normal.cn: ennui 是同一个法语名词的更深一层：恼火也能长成倦怠。

normal.en: Be annoyed at a thing, be annoyed with a person.
normal.cn: 对事用 be annoyed at，对人用 be annoyed with。

normal.en: Annoyance is the feeling; annoying is the thing that causes it.
normal.cn: annoyance 是感受，annoying 是引发感受的东西。

normal.en: The word weakened over centuries from trouble to mild irritation.
normal.cn: 这个词在几百年间从「烦扰」弱化成「轻微恼怒」。

abstract.en: Picture a small insect circling an ear, brushed away, returning again and again.
abstract.cn: 想象一只小虫绕着耳朵飞，被赶走又一遍遍回来。

abstract.en: Picture a stone in a shoe that cannot be taken out until the end of a long walk.
abstract.cn: 想象鞋里的一颗石子，整段长路都取不出来。

abstract.en: Picture a dripping tap at night, one drop at a time, wearing patience thin.
abstract.cn: 想象夜里滴水的水龙头，一滴接一滴，把耐心磨薄。

examples.en: The repeated rustling began to annoy everyone at the long table.
examples.cn: 反复的窸窣声开始让长桌旁所有人都心烦。

examples.en: The boy annoyed his sister until she gave him the book.
examples.cn: 男孩一直缠着姐姐，直到她把书给了他。

examples.en: She was annoyed with herself for forgetting the meeting.
examples.cn: 她因为忘了会议而生自己的气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额闹一」——额头上青筋一闹，心里就烦一分：使恼怒

root: 拉丁语短语 in odio「在憎恨之中」来自 odium「憎恨」，经古法语动词 enuier「使烦扰」进入英语为 annoy，最初是较强的「伤害、烦扰」义，现代弱化为轻微的恼怒。同源名词 enui 还演变为英语 ennui「倦怠」。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses trace one small disturbance: mild anger, repeated pestering, old bodily discomfort, and the passive state of being irritated.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项沿着同一个小干扰展开：轻微恼怒、反复纠缠、旧时的身体不适，以及被动的恼火状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tiny disturbance returns again and again until patience wears thin.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个小小的干扰一再回来，直到耐心被磨薄。

branches.en: THE IRRITATION LINE: repeated small actions produce mild anger.
branches.cn: 恼怒线：反复的小动作产生轻微愤怒。

branches.en: THE PESTERING LINE: the disturbance is deliberate and keeps coming.
branches.cn: 纠缠线：干扰是刻意的，而且不断到来。

branches.en: THE BODY LINE: the older broad sense covered physical discomfort.
branches.cn: 身体线：较早的宽泛词义包括身体上的不适。

branches.en: THE PASSIVE LINE: the person is on the receiving end of the disturbance.
branches.cn: 被动线：人处在承受干扰的一端。

branches.en: THE SHARED LINE: deliberate pestering and passive irritation are two sides of one exchange.
branches.cn: 交互线：刻意纠缠与被动恼火是同一次互动的两面。

intro.en: Annoy is a French verb from a Latin hatred phrase; English adds the usual noun and participle endings.
intro.cn: annoy 是来自拉丁语「憎恨」短语的法语动词，英语再为它加上普通的名词与分词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin odium and odiosus are recorded, and the French forms are documented; nothing here is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 odium 与 odiosus 都有记录，法语形式也有文献可查，这里没有重构形式。

items.example: It locates the person inside hatred.
items.exampleCN: 它把人放在憎恨之中。

items.example: It is the key word of the old phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个古老短语的关键词。

items.example: It is the root behind the French verb.
items.exampleCN: 它是法语动词背后的词根。

items.example: It later became English ennui.
items.exampleCN: 它后来变成英语的 ennui。

items.example: English took this verb as annoy.
items.exampleCN: 英语把这个动词借入为 annoy。

items.example: The verb also has a passive life.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词也常以被动形式出现。

items.example: It forms annoyance.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 annoyance。

items.example: It forms annoying.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 annoying。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ance 构成，义为「烦恼；恼人的事」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「感到恼火的」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「令人恼火的」

definition_zh: 每年的；年度的；一年一次的；年刊；一年生植物
definition_en: happening or produced once a year, or calculated over a year; also a plant that lives for one year or a yearly publication
core_image: 日历翻过一整圈，又回到同一个月份
scene: 年底的会议室里，财务把一摞报表推到桌子中央，封面写着年份。The annual report showed a small but steady rise in sales.
sceneCN: 这里 annual 是「年度的」（第 1 个义项：按一整年计算或每年发布的）；句意为年度报告显示销售有小幅而稳定的增长。画面里有年底的会议室、一摞报表与写有年份的封面。

pos.zh: 形容词：每年的；年度的；一年一次的
名词：年刊；年鉴；一年生植物

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「每年；一年一次地」
由拉丁语 annus「年」加 -ity 构成，义为「年金」，与本词同根
由拉丁语 annus「年」加 vertere「转」构成，义为「周年纪念」，与本词同根

senses.title: Calculated over a year
senses.definition: covering, calculated for, or produced in one year
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖一整年、按一整年计算或在一年内产生的
senses.example: The annual report showed a small but steady rise in sales.
senses.exampleCN: 年度报告显示销售有小幅而稳定的增长。
senses.why: Latin annus is a year, and annuus is yearly: the adjective first marks the span of one full turn of the seasons.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 annus 是「年」，annuus 是「每年的」：这个形容词首先标出四季转一整圈的跨度。

senses.title: Happening once a year
senses.definition: happening or held once every year
senses.definitionCN: 每年发生或举办一次
senses.example: The village holds an annual fair in the first week of autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子每年秋天第一周举办集市。
senses.why: A yearly span also supplies a natural rhythm: one event per turn of the calendar.
senses.whyCN: 一年的跨度也提供了天然节律：日历转一圈，事件发生一次。

senses.title: A plant living one year
senses.definition: a plant that completes its life cycle within a single growing season
senses.definitionCN: 在单个生长季内完成整个生命周期的植物
senses.example: Marigolds are annuals and must be planted again each spring.
senses.exampleCN: 万寿菊是一年生植物，每年春天都要重新播种。
senses.why: The adjective turns into a noun for a plant whose whole life fits inside one year.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转成名词，指那种整个生命都装进一年里的植物。

senses.title: A yearly publication
senses.definition: a book, magazine or report published once a year
senses.definitionCN: 每年出版一次的书籍、杂志或报告
senses.example: The society publishes an annual every December.
senses.exampleCN: 该学会每年十二月出版一本年刊。
senses.why: The thing published on the yearly rhythm borrows the adjective that describes the rhythm.
senses.whyCN: 按年度节律出版的东西，直接借用了描述这个节律的形容词。

intro.en: Annual comes from the Latin word for year, and the whole family is built on the turning of the seasons.
intro.cn: annual 来自拉丁语的「年」字，整个词族都建在四季轮转之上。

items.en: Annus meant 'year', the basic unit of the calendar in Roman life.
items.cn: annus 意为「年」，是罗马生活中历法的基本单位。

items.en: The adjective annuus meant 'yearly, of a year', formed directly on annus.
items.cn: 形容词 annuus 意为「每年的、一年的」，直接由 annus 构成。

items.en: Annus plus vertere 'to turn' produced anniversarius, 'returning every year', the source of anniversary.
items.cn: annus 加 vertere「转」产生 anniversarius「每年回转的」，是 anniversary 的来源。

items.en: French annual carried the adjective into administrative and everyday use before English borrowed it.
items.cn: 法语 annual 把这个形容词带入行政与日常使用，随后英语借入。

items.en: English borrowed annual as an adjective and later made it a noun; exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 英语借入 annual 作形容词，后来又把它们名词化；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Finance, gardening and publishing each add a strong everyday sense: annual report, annual plant, annual volume.
items.cn: 金融、园艺与出版各自增加了一个稳固的日常义项：年度报告、一年生植物、年刊。

note.en: The look-alike group is the year family; the near-meaning group gathers words about frequency and duration.
note.cn: 形近组收「年」词族；近义组收表示频率与持续时间的词。

entries.definition: Adverb: once a year or every year.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「每年；一年一次地」，由本词加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: A fixed sum paid once a year, especially for a pension or investment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「年金」，指每年支付的一笔固定款项，多用于养老金或投资。

entries.definition: The yearly return of a date, literally a year-turn.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「周年纪念」，字面就是「一年转回来」。

entries.definition: The plainer everyday synonym for annual, with the same two senses.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或副词，义为「每年的、一年一次地」，是 annual 更日常的同义词。

entries.definition: Happening twice a year, not once every two years; the prefix is bi- 'two'.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「一年两次的」，不是「两年一次」；前缀 bi- 表示「二」，需与 biennial 区分。

entries.definition: A plant that lives for several years, the opposite of an annual.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，义为「多年生植物」，与一年生植物相对。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin year word, its compounds, and the nouns English made from the adjective.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语「年」词、它的复合词，以及英语由形容词造出的名词。

normal.en: Annus is year; annuus is yearly; annual is the English adjective from the same stem.
normal.cn: annus 是年，annuus 是每年的，annual 是从同一词干来的英语形容词。

normal.en: Anniversary is literally a year-turn: annus plus vertere.
normal.cn: anniversary 字面是「一年转回」：annus 加 vertere。

normal.en: An annuity is money that comes back once a year.
normal.cn: annuity 是每年回转的一笔钱。

normal.en: An annual plant lives exactly one growing season; a perennial comes back.
normal.cn: 一年生植物只活一个生长季，多年生植物则会回来。

normal.en: Biannual is twice a year; biennial is every two years. Do not confuse them.
normal.cn: biannual 是一年两次，biennial 是两年一次，不要混淆。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar flipped all the way around and landing on the same month again.
abstract.cn: 想象一本日历被整整翻过一圈，又落回同一个月。

abstract.en: Picture a circle of seasons with one marker that passes the same point exactly once each turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一个四季围成的圆，有一个标记每转一圈正好经过同一点一次。

abstract.en: Picture a flower that grows, blooms, drops seed and disappears before the year closes.
abstract.cn: 想象一朵花在一年结束前就长成、开放、落籽、消失。

examples.en: The annual report showed a small but steady rise in sales.
examples.cn: 年度报告显示销售有小幅而稳定的增长。

examples.en: The village holds an annual fair in the first week of autumn.
examples.cn: 这个村子每年秋天第一周举办集市。

examples.en: Marigolds are annuals and must be planted again each spring.
examples.cn: 万寿菊是一年生植物，每年春天都要重新播种。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安牛」——安安稳稳一年养一头牛，每年都如此：每年的

root: 拉丁语 annus「年」构成形容词 annuus「每年的」，经法语 annual 进入英语。同一词根还产生 anniversarius「每年回转的」（annus + vertere）与 annuitas「年金」。现代英语由形容词又名词化出「年刊」与「一年生植物」两义。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses follow one full turn of the calendar: a yearly calculation, a once-a-year event, a plant that lives one season, and a publication issued once a year.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项沿着日历转一整圈：按年计算、一年一次的活动、只活一季的植物，以及每年出版一次的刊物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the calendar turns a full circle and returns to the same month.
core.cn: 核心意象：日历转过整整一圈，又回到同一个月。

branches.en: THE SPAN LINE: everything calculated or produced across one year.
branches.cn: 跨度线：在一整年内计算或产生的一切。

branches.en: THE RHYTHM LINE: one event per turn of the calendar.
branches.cn: 节律线：日历转一圈发生一次的事件。

branches.en: THE PLANT LINE: a life cycle that fits inside one growing season.
branches.cn: 植物线：整个生命周期装进一个生长季。

branches.en: THE PUBLICATION LINE: a volume issued on the yearly rhythm.
branches.cn: 出版线：按年度节律发行的一本书或一期刊物。

branches.en: THE SHARED LINE: the yearly span and the yearly event are the same cycle seen as length and as beat.
branches.cn: 共同线：年度跨度与年度事件是同一个循环，一个看成长度，一个看成节拍。

intro.en: Annual is Latin annus plus the adjective ending -uus; English adds -ly and the noun plural.
intro.cn: annual 是拉丁语 annus 加形容词词尾 -uus；英语再加 -ly 与名词复数词尾。

latinIntro.en: Annus, annuus and anniversarius are recorded Latin words, so this family needs no reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: annus、annuus 与 anniversarius 都是有记录的拉丁词，因此这一词族无需重构。

items.example: It is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 它是整个词族的词根。

items.example: It appears in annual and annuity.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 annual 与 annuity 中。

items.example: It is the direct source of annual.
items.exampleCN: 它是 annual 的直接来源。

items.example: It forms the English adjective annual.
items.exampleCN: 它构成英语形容词 annual。

items.example: It joins annus with vertere 'to turn'.
items.exampleCN: 它把 annus 与 vertere「转」接在一起。

items.example: It keeps the yearly money sense.
items.exampleCN: 它保留了「按年付钱」的义项。

items.meaning: in the stated manner or rate
items.example: It forms annually.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 annually。

items.example: It forms annuals.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 annuals。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「每年；一年一次地」
由拉丁语 annus 加 -ity 构成，义为「年金」
由拉丁语 annus 加 vertere 构成，义为「周年纪念」

definition_zh: 另一个；再一个；另外的；别的；类似的；再（时间或距离）
definition_en: one more of the same kind, a different one, or an additional amount
core_image: 手里已经有一个，又伸手去拿同类的下一个
scene: 面摊前，孩子吃完一碗，把空碗往前一推，眼睛还盯着锅里。He asked for another bowl before his mother had finished her own.
sceneCN: 这里 another 是「再来一个、另一个」（第 1 个义项：同类中的又一个）；句意为母亲还没吃完，他就又要了一碗。画面里有面摊、空碗与盯着锅里的孩子。

pos.zh: 限定词：另一个；再一个；另外的
代词：另一个（人或物）

derivatives.zh: 与本词同源，义为「其他的」，another 由 an 加 other 合成
由 other 加 -wise 构成，义为「否则；以别的方式」，与本词同源
由 other 加 -ness 构成，义为「他者性；不同之处」，与本词同源

senses.title: One more of the same kind
senses.titleCN: 另一个（同类中的又一个）
senses.definition: one more person or thing of the same kind as the one already mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 与已提到的那个同类，再加一个
senses.example: He asked for another bowl before his mother had finished her own.
senses.exampleCN: 母亲还没吃完，他就又要了一碗。
senses.why: An plus other: the indefinite article adds one more to the other that is already counted.
senses.whyCN: an 加 other：不定冠词在已经数过的「另一个」之上，再添上一个。

senses.title: An additional amount
senses.definition: used before a number or amount to mean an additional one of the same size
senses.definitionCN: 用于数量词前，表示再增加同样大小的一个量
senses.example: We waited another twenty minutes for the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 我们又等了二十分钟才等到公交车。
senses.why: The same 'one more' logic applies to a measured amount, so another can mean an extra stretch of time or distance.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「再来一个」的逻辑也能用在计量上，于是 another 可指再加一段时间的或一段距离。

senses.title: A different one
senses.definition: a different person or thing, not the one already mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 与已提到的不同的人或物
senses.example: That is another matter, and we should discuss it separately.
senses.exampleCN: 那是另一回事，我们应该分开讨论。
senses.why: Other also means different, so an other can shift from 'one more of these' to 'not this one at all'.
senses.whyCN: other 同时也表示「不同的」，因此 an other 可以从「再来一个同类」滑向「完全不是这一个」。

senses.title: Another as a pronoun
senses.definition: used alone as a pronoun for an additional or different person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 单独作代词，指另一个或不同的人或物
senses.example: This pen is dry; please give me another.
senses.exampleCN: 这支笔没水了，请给我另一支。
senses.why: When the noun is already clear from context, it can be dropped and another stands alone.
senses.whyCN: 当名词从上下文已经清楚时，就可以省掉，让 another 独自站立。

senses.title: A second person like the first
senses.definition: used before a proper name to mean a second person with the same qualities
senses.definitionCN: 用于专有名词前，表示具有同样品质的第二个人
senses.example: The young pianist is another Mozart in the making.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻钢琴家是又一个正在成长的莫扎特。
senses.why: A name stands for a whole set of qualities, so another name means the qualities have appeared again.
senses.whyCN: 一个名字代表一整套品质，因此「又一个某名字」意味着那套品质再次出现。

senses.title: One another, mutually
senses.definition: in the reciprocal phrase one another, each of two or more people acting toward the others
senses.definitionCN: 在互指短语 one another 中，两个或更多人各自对他人施加动作
senses.example: The two sisters wrote to one another every week.
senses.exampleCN: 两姐妹每周互相写信。
senses.why: One is matched with another so that the action runs in both directions at once.
senses.whyCN: one 与 another 配对，使动作同时朝两个方向进行。

intro.en: Another is not a borrowed word but two Old English words that fused into one.
intro.cn: another 不是借词，而是两个古英语词融合成一个。

items.en: The word ōþer meant 'other, the second of two'. It is the ancestor of modern other.
items.cn: ōþer 意为「另一个、两者中的第二个」，是现代词 other 的祖先。

items.en: The numeral ān meant 'one', the same word that gives the article an.
items.cn: 数词 ān 意为「一」，也是冠词 an 的来源。

items.en: The reconstructed form *anþaraz underlies other; it is a reconstruction, not a recorded word.
items.cn: 重构形式 *anþaraz 是 other 的更深来源；它属重构，不是有记录的词。

items.en: The phrase an other contracts into the single word another, with the two parts still visible in the spelling.
items.cn: 短语 an other 缩合成单词 another，两个部分在拼写上仍看得见。

items.en: Another covers one more, a different one, an extra amount and the reciprocal one another; the pieces are no longer separable.
items.cn: another 覆盖「再来一个」「另一个不同的」「额外一份」以及互指的 one another；两个部分已不可再拆开。

note.en: The look-alike group is the other family; the near-meaning group gathers determiners of addition and difference.
note.cn: 形近组收 other 词族；近义组收表示追加与差异的限定词。

entries.definition: A different or additional person or thing; the second half of another.
entries.definitionCN: 限定词或代词，义为「其他的、另一个」，是 another 的后半部分。

entries.definition: In another way, or if not; built on other plus -wise.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「否则、以别的方式」，由 other 加 -wise 构成。

entries.definition: The quality of being different or foreign.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「他者性、不同之处」，指与己不同的性质。

entries.definition: Extra, added on; more formal than another in the sense of one more.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「额外的、附加的」，在「再来一个」义上比 another 更正式。

entries.definition: More than what is usual or expected, often charged separately.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或副词，义为「额外的」，指超出平常或预期，常需另外付费。

entries.definition: Not the same; closer to the third sense of another.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不同的」，接近 another 的第三个义项。

entries.definition: Additional in distance, time or degree.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或副词，义为「进一步的、更远的」，用于距离、时间或程度上的追加。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real fusion of an and other, and the senses that grew out of it.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用 an 与 other 的真实融合，以及由此长出的各义项。

normal.en: Another is literally an other: one more other thing.
normal.cn: another 字面就是 an other：再加一个「别的」东西。

normal.en: The spelling still shows the seam: an + other.
normal.cn: 拼写里仍看得见接缝：an 加 other。

normal.en: Another twenty minutes keeps the same one-more logic for a measured amount.
normal.cn: another twenty minutes 把同一个「再来一份」的逻辑用到计量上。

normal.en: One another is reciprocal: the action runs both ways.
normal.cn: one another 是互指：动作朝两个方向跑。

normal.en: Another Mozart means the same qualities have appeared in a second person.
normal.cn: another Mozart 意味着同一套品质在第二个人身上再次出现。

abstract.en: Picture a hand already holding one ripe apple, reaching for the next one on the branch.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手已握着一个熟苹果，又伸向枝上的下一个。

abstract.en: Picture two identical doors side by side, one open, the other still shut.
abstract.cn: 想象两扇一模一样的门并排，一扇开着，另一扇还关着。

abstract.en: Picture two mirrors facing each other, the same light bouncing back and forth.
abstract.cn: 想象两面相对的镜子，同一束光来回反弹。

examples.en: He asked for another bowl before his mother had finished her own.
examples.cn: 母亲还没吃完，他就又要了一碗。

examples.en: We waited another twenty minutes for the bus.
examples.cn: 我们又等了二十分钟才等到公交车。

examples.en: The two sisters wrote to one another every week.
examples.cn: 两姐妹每周互相写信。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿纳德」——阿德手里一个，又伸手要另一个：另一个

root: 古英语数词 ān「一」与 ōþer「另一个」合成短语 an other，在中古英语中缩合为单词 another，拼写仍保留两个部分的接缝。ōþer 可追溯到重构的原始日耳曼语 *anþaraz；这两个部分在现代英语中已不可再拆分。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses grow from one fusion: another of the same kind, an extra amount, a different thing, a pronoun standing alone, a second person like the first, and the reciprocal one another.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项从一个融合体长出：同类中的又一个、额外一份、不同的一件、单独作代词、像第一个的第二人，以及互指的 one another。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand already holding one thing reaches for the next of the same kind.
core.cn: 核心意象：手里已拿着一个东西，又伸向同类的下一个。

branches.en: THE ONE-MORE LINE: an additional member of the same kind.
branches.cn: 再一个线：同类中额外的一个成员。

branches.en: THE AMOUNT LINE: an extra measured stretch of time, distance or quantity.
branches.cn: 数量线：额外的一段可计量的时间、距离或数量。

branches.en: THE DIFFERENCE LINE: not this one but a different one.
branches.cn: 差异线：不是这一个，而是不同的另一个。

branches.en: THE PRONOUN LINE: the noun is dropped and another stands alone.
branches.cn: 代词线：名词被省掉，another 独自站立。

branches.en: THE NAME AND RECIPROCAL LINE: a proper name can recur, and one another sends the action both ways.
branches.cn: 名字与互指线：专名可以再次出现，而 one another 让动作双向进行。

intro.en: Another is a fused phrase, not an affixed word; its parts are the article an and the adjective other.
intro.cn: another 是融合的短语，不是加缀词；它的组成部分是冠词 an 与形容词 other。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word is a genuine cognate here; alter and alius mean similar things but come from a different root, so the Latin list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有真正的拉丁同源词；alter 与 alius 意思相近，却来自不同词根，因此拉丁同源列表留空。

items.example: It supplies the one in another.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 another 里的「一个」。

items.example: It is the second half of another.
items.exampleCN: 它是 another 的后半部分。

items.example: It is the recorded ancestor of other.
items.exampleCN: 它是 other 有记录的祖先。

items.example: This form is reconstructed, not attested.
items.exampleCN: 这个形式是重构的，没有文献证据。

items.example: Other keeps this old comparative shape.
items.exampleCN: other 保留了这个古老的比较形态。

items.meaning: one more or a different one
items.example: The phrase became one word.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语凝固成了一个词。

items.example: It keeps the parts visible.
items.exampleCN: 它让两个部分仍然可见。

items.example: It is the close synonym of one another.
items.exampleCN: 它是 one another 的近义说法。
